exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Thoracic Rotation
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front of you, both knees bent to right angles. Reach both arms straight out in front at shoulder height, palms together.

**Movement.** Open the arm on the side of your front leg out and back, turning your chest and eyes with it until the arm points behind you, then bring it back to meet the other hand. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips facing forward and your front knee over your foot.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a high cable. Kneel on one knee facing the machine, the other foot flat in front of you, and reach up to take the handle in the hand on the side of your down knee, arm straight.

**Movement.** Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, elbow going down toward your hip, then let it rise until your arm is straight overhead. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and square to the machine, without leaning back or twisting.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Box Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg a short step in front of a sturdy box or bench, facing away from it. Lift the other foot a little off the floor in front of you and reach your arms forward.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and bend your standing knee to sit down until you touch the box, then stand back up on the same leg. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your free foot off the floor, your chest up and your standing knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Multi-Directional Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Step out with one leg and lower into a lunge, then push back to standing. Each time, change the direction of the step: forward, forward at 45 degrees, out to the side, and backward. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your stepping knee in line with its toes and your other foot planted.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit down on the floor. Bend one leg across the front of your body and the other out to the side behind you, both knees at about a right angle, and put your hands on the floor behind you.

**Movement.** Lift both knees and swing them over to the other side, so the legs swap roles and finish in the mirrored position. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your feet about where they started, turning on the spot, and your chest tall.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on a mat with an ab wheel on the floor in front of your knees. Hold a handle in each hand, arms straight and shoulders over the wheel.

**Movement.** Roll the wheel forward, letting your hips and arms reach out together until your body is close to straight and just above the floor, then roll it back toward your knees.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips not sagging and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Abdominal Draw-In
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, arms resting at your sides.

**Movement.** Pull your belly button in toward your spine so your stomach flattens, and hold it there for the set time. Then let your belly go back out.

**Keep steady.** Your hips, ribs and back still, so only your belly moves, and your lower back in its natural curve, neither pressed down nor lifted.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall beside a wall or rack with one hand resting on it, your weight on the leg nearer the support.

**Movement.** Lift your outside leg straight out to the side as far as it goes without tipping your body, then lower it back beside the other. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your toes pointing forward and your standing knee slightly bent.

exercises.name: Active Hang
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take a pull-up bar overhead with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, and lift your feet so you hang on straight arms.

**Movement.** Draw your shoulder blades down so your neck looks longer, elbows still straight, and stay in that hang for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your legs still and together, and your body not swinging.

exercises.name: Adductor Rock-Back
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours, shoulders over your hands and hips over your knees. Straighten one leg out sideways, its whole foot flat and toes forward.

**Movement.** Sit your hips back toward the heel of your kneeling leg until the inside of your straight leg pulls, then rock forward to the start. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and the foot of your straight leg flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Alternating Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight at your sides, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Bend one elbow to curl that dumbbell up toward your shoulder, lower it until your arm is straight, then curl the other. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Alternating Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.

**Movement.** Curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder with your palm still facing in, lower it until your arm is straight, then curl the other. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight, without swinging.

exercises.name: Gorilla Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet wide and a dumbbell on the floor inside each foot. Push your hips back and bend your knees until your torso is close to level with the floor, and take a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.

**Movement.** Row one dumbbell up to the side of your ribs while the other stays on the floor, then lower it back down and row the other. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips still and your shoulders square to the floor.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Rock
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat on the floor in front of you and your hands resting on your front knee.

**Movement.** Rock your front knee forward past your toes as far as it goes with the heel down, then rock back to the start. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your front heel on the floor and your knee travelling over your middle toes.

exercises.name: Ankle Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a bench or the floor and straighten one leg out in front of you so the foot is clear of the floor.

**Movement.** Draw a full circle with your toes, moving only at the ankle, then circle the other way. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your leg still and your knee straight, with the circle coming from the ankle alone.

exercises.name: Arch Hang
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull your shoulders down and back away from your ears and lift your chest toward the bar so your upper back arches, then hold that position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows straight throughout, your legs together and your body without swinging.

exercises.name: Archer Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about twice shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up toward one hand, bending that arm while the other straightens out along the bar, until your chin is beside the bent arm's hand. Lower back to a straight-arm hang, then pull toward the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still and together, and your body not swinging.

exercises.name: T-Y-I Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down on a mat with your arms straight overhead, thumbs pointing up, and your forehead just off the floor.

**Movement.** Lift your straight arms off the floor in a Y and lower them. Move them out to the sides and lift them in a T, lower them, then bring them down beside your hips and lift them in an I. One of each is a rep.

**Keep steady.** Your chest and hips on the floor, your legs relaxed and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a bench with its back set upright. Bring a dumbbell in each hand up to shoulder height, your palms turned toward your face and your elbows pointing forward.

**Movement.** Press the dumbbells overhead, turning your hands as they rise so your palms face forward when your arms are straight. Lower them along the same path, turning your palms back toward you at the bottom.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad, your feet flat and your wrists straight.

exercises.name: Assisted Chin-Up (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the counterweight, then kneel on the pad or stand on the platform and take the handles with your palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is over your hands, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright and still on the pad, without kicking or leaning back.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Loop a band over a pull-up bar and pull one end through the other so it hangs down. Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away, and put one knee or foot in the loop, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still in the band, without kicking or swinging.

exercises.name: Back Bridge
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat near your hips. Put your hands on the floor beside your ears, fingers pointing toward your shoulders, elbows up.

**Movement.** Push through your hands and feet to lift your hips and back off the floor until your arms are straight and your body forms an arch, then bend your arms and lower your back to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your hands and feet flat, your knees in line with your feet and your head hanging between your arms at the top.

exercises.name: Back Lever
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar or rings, tuck your knees, and roll your legs back up between your arms until you hang upside down with your hips past your hands.

**Movement.** Lower your body, arms straight, until it is level with the floor and facing down, and hold it there for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your body in one line from shoulders to feet and your hips not bending.

exercises.name: Back Neck Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall and clasp your hands behind your head.

**Movement.** Lower your chin toward your chest and let the weight of your hands add a light pull, until you feel the stretch along the back of your neck. Hold it for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your back upright and your shoulders down, the bend coming from your neck only.

exercises.name: Backward Arm Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms straight at your sides.

**Movement.** Swing your straight arms forward and up past your ears, then back and down past your hips in one big circle. Keep circling the same way; each full circle is a rep.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your body upright and your lower back still.

exercises.name: Shoulder Circle
aliases: Arm Circles With Hands on Shoulders
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand or sit tall and rest your fingertips on the tops of your shoulders, elbows out to the sides.

**Movement.** Draw large circles with your elbows, taking them up, back, down and forward so your shoulders roll backward. Do the set number of circles backward, then the same forward.

**Keep steady.** Your fingertips on your shoulders, your back upright and your head still.

exercises.name: Swiss Ball Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a Swiss ball and walk your feet forward until the ball is under your lower back, feet flat about hip-width apart. Rest your hands lightly behind your head or cross them on your chest.

**Movement.** Let your upper back curve back over the ball, then curl your head and shoulders up and forward until your upper back lifts off it, and lower back down.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level, the ball still and your hands not pulling on your head.

exercises.name: Ball Slam
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a slam ball in both hands at your waist, standing tall with your feet set a shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Lift the ball overhead on straight arms, rising onto your toes, then throw it down onto the floor just in front of your feet as you bend your hips and knees. Pick it up and stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat as you bend to pick up the ball, and the ball landing between your feet or just ahead of them.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about hip-width apart. Hold an end in each hand, arms straight at your sides, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Curl your hands up toward your shoulders against the band, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without leaning back or rocking your body.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about hip-width apart. Push your hips back, bend your knees and hold an end of the band in each hand just outside your legs, arms straight and back flat.

**Movement.** Push the floor away and stand up until your hips and knees are straight, stretching the band, then push your hips back to lower your hands toward the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and your hands close to your legs.

exercises.name: Finger Extension (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Loop a small rubber band around the tips of all five fingers of one hand, fingers and thumb together.

**Movement.** Open your fingers and thumb as wide as they go against the band, then let them close back together. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your wrist straight and your forearm still.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about hip-width apart. Hold an end in each hand at your sides, arms straight, palms facing each other.

**Movement.** Curl your hands up toward your shoulders with your palms still facing each other, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the front of a bench or box with a band looped around your thighs just above your knees, feet flat on the floor and hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Push your knees out to the sides against the band as far as they go, then let them come back in.

**Keep steady.** Your feet flat on the floor, your torso upright and your hips on the seat.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Adduction (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Anchor a band low beside you and loop it around the ankle nearer the anchor. Stand side-on, one hand on a rack or wall, and step away until the band pulls that leg out to the side.

**Movement.** Sweep the banded leg in and across in front of your standing leg, then let it go back out to the side. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips square, your torso upright and your standing leg still.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about hip-width apart. Hold an end in each hand at your sides, palms facing in, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Raise your arms out to the sides until your hands reach shoulder height, then lower them back to your sides.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, your feet flat on the band and your elbows keeping the same small bend.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it, feet about shoulder-width apart. Hold the band's end in both hands at the middle of your chest, far enough out that it pulls.

**Movement.** Press your hands straight out from your chest until your arms are straight, then bring them back in. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders and hips facing forward and your hands in line with your chest, without letting the band turn you.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding a band in both hands in front of your belly, palms up, elbows bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your sides.

**Movement.** Turn your forearms out to the sides, stretching the band, as far as your shoulders allow, then let your hands come back in front of you.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows against your sides and bent to the same angle, and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Pull-Apart (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding a band with both hands, palms down and about shoulder-width apart, arms straight and reaching forward level with your shoulders.

**Movement.** Spread your arms out to the sides until the band touches your chest, then let your hands come back together in front of you.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight at shoulder height, your shoulders down and your body upright without leaning back.

exercises.name: Pull-Through (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Anchor a band low behind you. Face away from it, hold the band with both hands between your legs and walk forward until it is taut, feet a little wider than your hips.

**Movement.** Push your hips back so your hands follow the band back between your legs and your chest tips toward the floor, then bring your hips forward to stand up straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and your knees only slightly bent.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about hip-width apart. Hold an end in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows under your hands.

**Movement.** Press your hands up until your arms are straight overhead, then lower them back to shoulder height.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, your feet flat on the band and your elbows under your hands, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Anchor a band low in front of you and loop it behind one knee. Step back until it pulls, that foot flat and the knee slightly bent, the other foot a little behind on its toes.

**Movement.** Straighten the banded knee against the band until your leg is fully straight, then let it bend again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your banded foot flat, your hips and torso still and the band at knee height.

exercises.name: Ankle Mobilization (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Loop a band around the front of one ankle with its other end anchored low behind you. Kneel on your other knee with the banded foot flat on the floor ahead, so the band draws the ankle back.

**Movement.** Drive your front knee forward past your toes as far as it goes with the heel down, then ease back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your front heel on the floor and the band low on your ankle.

exercises.name: Clamshell (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Loop a band around your thighs just above your knees. Lie on your side with your hips and knees bent, legs stacked and your head resting on your lower arm.

**Movement.** Keeping your feet together, lift your top knee as far as it opens, then lower it back to the other knee. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips stacked and still, without rolling back, and your feet touching.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about hip-width apart. Take an end of the band in each hand, hands resting against your thighs, palms facing back, arms straight.

**Movement.** Raise your hands in front of you until they reach shoulder height, then lower them back to your thighs.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright without leaning back, and a small bend in your elbows that stays the same.

exercises.name: Monster Walk (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Loop a mini band around your legs just above your knees. Set your feet about hip-width apart, enough to pull the band taut, then bend into a quarter squat.

**Movement.** Step forward and out at an angle with one foot, then bring the other foot forward and out the same way, walking forward. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** The same quarter squat throughout, the band taut and your knees out over your toes.

exercises.name: Scapular Retraction (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Anchor a band at shoulder height. Face it, slip one arm into the loop so it sits just above your elbow, and step back until the band is taut, that arm reaching forward.

**Movement.** Draw your elbow and shoulder straight back, bringing your shoulder blade toward your spine, then let them go forward with the band. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso facing the anchor without twisting, and your shoulder down away from your ear.

exercises.name: Ab Rollout (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Load a barbell with round plates and kneel behind it on a mat. Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart, arms straight and shoulders over the bar.

**Movement.** Roll the bar forward, letting your hips and arms reach out together until your body is close to straight and just above the floor, then roll it back toward your knees.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips not sagging and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on the floor in a rack under a bar set low on its hooks, eyes under the bar, knees bent and feet flat. Grip it a little wider than your shoulders and lift it over your chest, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar toward your chest until your upper arms rest on the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees from your sides, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your upper back and hips on the floor, your feet flat and your wrists straight.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on a mat with a padded barbell across your hips, holding it either side. Bend your knees and plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Push through your heels to lift your hips and the bar until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, then lower your hips back to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your upper back and feet on the floor, the bar steady on your hips and your knees in line with your feet.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your heels close in front of a barbell resting on the floor, feet about hip-width apart. Squat down and take the bar behind you with an overhand grip, arms straight.

**Movement.** Stand up, the bar sliding up the backs of your legs, until your hips and knees are straight, then squat back down to set it on the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your back flat and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back, hands just wider than your shoulders. Step back and stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Step forward with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to step back to standing. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, the bar level and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back, hands just wider than your shoulders. Step back to open floor and stand with your feet together.

**Movement.** Take a long step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot and bring your back foot through into the next step. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, the bar level and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a bench holding a bar palms down, hands about shoulder-width apart. Lay your forearms along your thighs with your wrists just beyond your knees.

**Movement.** Let your wrists bend down to lower the bar, then lift the backs of your hands up as high as they go.

**Keep steady.** Your forearms on your thighs and your elbows still.

exercises.name: Underhand Bent-Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart. Push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is at about 45 degrees or lower, knees slightly bent, the bar hanging at arm's length.

**Movement.** Pull the bar to your lower ribs, elbows going back close to your sides, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The same torso angle, your back flat, and no jerking with your hips.

exercises.name: Silverback Shrug (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold the bar with an overhand grip just wider than your shoulders. Push your hips back and lean forward to about 45 degrees, knees slightly bent, the bar hanging at arm's length.

**Movement.** Pull your shoulder blades back and up toward your ears without bending your elbows, then let them go forward and down again.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your back flat and the same lean throughout.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell over your chest with an overhand grip, hands a little narrower than shoulder-width, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, then straighten your arms to press it back up over your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms still and pointing up, with your elbows kept in.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take the bar from a rack at shoulder height onto your upper back, hands either side of your shoulders, and step back. Set your feet in a long split stance, one well ahead of the other, back heel lifted.

**Movement.** Bend both knees and lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push back up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your feet in place, the bar level and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back, hands either side of your shoulders. Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a plate or low step and your heels hanging off.

**Movement.** Push up through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as they go, then lower them below the edge.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight, your body upright and the bar level across your back.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back, hands just wider than your shoulders. Step back and stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Reach one foot a long step back and bend both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to bring the back foot forward to standing. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, the bar level and your front shin close to upright.

exercises.name: Step-Up (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back, hands either side of your shoulders. Stand facing a sturdy box or bench about knee height and put one foot flat on top of it.

**Movement.** Push through that foot to step up until your leg is straight, bringing the other foot up beside it, then step back down with the other foot first. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, the bar level across your back and your working knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the bar in a rack at shoulder height, step under it and rest it across your upper back, hands either side of your shoulders. Lift it off, step back and set your feet well wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.

**Movement.** Bend your knees out over your toes and sit straight down until your thighs are about level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your back flat, your heels down and your knees out in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and hold a bar overhead with a narrow overhand grip, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, then straighten your arms to lift it back overhead.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms beside your head and still, your elbows pointing forward and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding a barbell against the fronts of your thighs with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lift the bar straight up along your body, elbows going out and up, until your upper arms are about level with your shoulders. Lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows above your hands, the bar close to your body and your torso upright, without swinging.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a bench holding a bar palms up, hands about shoulder-width apart. Lay your forearms along your thighs with your wrists just beyond your knees.

**Movement.** Let your wrists bend back to lower the bar, then curl them up as high as they go.

**Keep steady.** Your forearms on your thighs and your elbows still.

exercises.name: Battle Rope Wave
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold one end of a battle rope in each hand at hip height, palms facing in, and step back until the rope is almost straight. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees and hips slightly bent.

**Movement.** Raise and lower your arms in turn, fast, so waves run along both ropes to the anchor. Keep going for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and knees bent, your chest up and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Bayesian Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Take it in one hand, palm facing forward, and walk away with your back to the machine until your arm is drawn back behind your body. Stand in a split stance.

**Movement.** Curl the handle up toward your shoulder, then lower it until your arm is straight and behind you again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm angled back behind your body and still, and your torso leaning slightly forward.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor under your shoulders and your feet behind you, legs nearly straight, so your weight rests on your hands and toes with your hips high.

**Movement.** Walk forward by moving one hand and the opposite foot together, then the other hand and foot, and keep crawling for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and your weight shared between your hands and feet.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl Pull-Through (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips, a dumbbell on the floor just outside one hand. Lift your knees an inch or two off the floor.

**Movement.** Reach under your body with the far hand, drag the dumbbell across to the other side and put that hand back down. Pull it back with the other hand. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your knees off the floor, your back flat and your hips level, without rocking side to side.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Back Lateral Raise (Cable)
aliases: Behind the Back Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Stand side-on to it and take the handle in your far hand, so the cable runs behind your body, arm hanging by your side.

**Movement.** Raise your arm out to the side until your hand reaches shoulder height, then lower it back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright and still, with no lean or swing, and a small bend in your elbow.

exercises.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the platform and fasten the belt around your hips, the strap hanging between your legs. Hold the handles, set your feet about shoulder-width apart and stand up to lift the load off its rest.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your whole foot down and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor. Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out of the rack so it sits over your shoulders, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to the middle of your chest, touch it lightly, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulder blades pulled back into the bench, your hips down and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Bench Press Hold (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench under a racked bar with your eyes under it and your feet flat. Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out over your chest, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar about halfway to your chest and stop it there, then hold it still for the set time before pressing it back up and racking it.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulder blades pulled back, your hips on the bench and the bar level over your chest.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench under a racked bar with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat. Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart and lift it out so it sits over your chest, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows close to your sides, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows tucked in, your shoulder blades pulled back and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
aliases: No Leg Drive Dumbbell Chest Press
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a flat bench with the dumbbells resting on your thighs. Lie back and press them up over your chest, arms straight, palms facing your feet.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest until your upper arms are level with the bench or a little below, then press them back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your feet flat, your hips on the bench and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, back flat and about level with the floor. Hold a dumbbell in the other hand, arm straight below your shoulder.

**Movement.** Pull the dumbbell up to the side of your waist, elbow going back past your body, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your shoulders square to the floor, without twisting.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in. Push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent, the dumbbells hanging below your shoulders.

**Movement.** Pull both dumbbells up to the sides of your waist, elbows going back past your body, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The same torso angle, your back flat, and no jerking with your hips.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row to External Rotation (Dumbbell)
aliases: Bent Over Row to External Rotation
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a light dumbbell in each hand. Push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent, arms hanging straight.

**Movement.** Lift your elbows out to the sides until your upper arms are level with your shoulders, forearms hanging down. Turn your forearms forward until they point the way your head faces, then turn them back and lower your arms.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms level with your shoulders, your elbows at a right angle and your back flat.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders. Push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent, the bar hanging at arm's length.

**Movement.** Pull the bar to your lower chest, elbows going back, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The same torso angle, your back flat, and no jerking with your hips.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so your upper arms lie on the pad and your elbows line up with the machine's pivot. Take the handles with your palms facing up, arms almost straight.

**Movement.** Curl the handles up toward your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are almost straight.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms on the pad and your shoulders still.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a straight bar to a low cable. Stand facing it, take the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart and step back so your arms hang straight with the cable taut.

**Movement.** Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand holding the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms straight, the bar in front of your thighs.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to curl the bar up toward your shoulders, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight at your sides, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip on the angled parts, arms straight, the bar in front of your thighs.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to curl the bar up toward your shoulders, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Bicep Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand side-on to a wall, about an arm's length away. Reach your near arm back and put your palm flat on the wall at shoulder height, thumb up, arm straight.

**Movement.** Turn your body away from the wall until you feel it along the front of your arm and shoulder. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight and your hand flat on the wall.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Face the anchor and take a handle in each hand, palms facing up. Walk your feet forward and lean back until your arms are straight in front of you at shoulder height and your body is straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to curl your body up until your hands are beside your forehead, then lower yourself until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and your upper arms still at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face up, fingertips resting behind your head. Raise your shoulders and both feet off the floor, knees bent.

**Movement.** Bring one knee in toward your chest as you twist to bring the opposite elbow toward it, straightening the other leg out. Switch sides in a pedalling motion. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back on the floor, your shoulders off it and your hands not pulling on your head.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, back flat.

**Movement.** Reach one arm straight forward and the opposite leg straight back until both are in line with your body, then bring them back under you. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your hips level, without turning or arching.

exercises.name: Black Widow Knee Slide
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a plank on your hands, hands under your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Bring one knee under your body and across toward the opposite elbow, sliding it up the back of that arm as far as it goes, then step it back. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hands under your shoulders and your hips low, about in line with your body.

exercises.name: Bobbing Drill
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in chest-deep water.

**Movement.** Breathe in, sink until your head is under, breathe out fully underwater, then push up to breathe in again. Repeat for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright and your face relaxed underwater.

exercises.name: Body-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Start in a forearm plank, forearms on the floor about shoulder-width apart and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Press your palms into the floor and straighten your elbows to lift your forearms off it until your arms are straight, then bend your elbows to lower your forearms back down.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and your hands where they started.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Bicep Curl
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bar in a rack at about waist height. Lie under it, take it with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart, and straighten your arms so your body hangs below it, straight from head to heels with your heels on the floor.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to bring your forehead up toward the bar, then lower yourself until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and your elbows still, so only your forearms move.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Hip Thrust
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench, knees bent and feet flat about hip-width apart. Cross your arms over your chest.

**Movement.** Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, then lower them back toward the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your upper back on the bench, your chin down and your shins about upright at the top.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little, arms in front of you or hands together at your chest.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your whole foot on the floor and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Box Pike Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your feet on a box behind you and walk your hands back toward it until your hips are over your shoulders and your torso is close to upside down, hands a little wider than your shoulders.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor just in front of your hands, then press back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your hips high over your shoulders and your elbows angled back rather than straight out.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a sturdy box about a foot away, feet hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and swing your arms back, then jump up onto the box, landing on both feet with your knees bent. Stand up tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.

**Keep steady.** Your knees in line with your toes as you take off and land, and your whole foot on the box.

exercises.name: Box Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a box or bench behind you at a height that puts your thighs about level with the floor when seated. Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back and stand a short step in front of the box, feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and bend your knees to sit down on the box, then stand back up from it.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Heavy Bag Work
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in front of a hanging bag in a boxing stance, one foot ahead of the other, knees soft and your hands up by your chin.

**Movement.** Throw straight punches and hooks into the bag in short combinations, moving your feet around it between them. Bring each hand back to your chin after it lands, and keep going for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hands up, your chin down and your weight on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Braced Squat (Plate)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders. Hold a weight plate by its sides at chest height, then press it out in front of you until your arms are straight.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** The plate at chest height on straight arms, your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Bretzel Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side with your head on a cushion. Bring your top knee up to hip height and hold it down with your bottom hand. Bend your bottom knee behind you and hold that foot with your top hand.

**Movement.** Turn your chest and top shoulder back toward the floor behind you, until you feel the stretch through your chest and the front of your back thigh. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your top knee pinned down and your hips stacked.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand behind a line with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Swing your arms back as you bend your hips and knees, then swing them forward and jump forward as far as you can. Land on both feet with your knees bent, stand up and walk back to the line.

**Keep steady.** Your feet side by side on take-off and landing, and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand a long step in front of a bench, facing away from it, and rest the top of one foot on it behind you.

**Movement.** Bend your front knee and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to stand back up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your front foot flat and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand about a stride in front of a bench, facing away, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Reach one foot back and rest its top on the bench.

**Movement.** Bend your front knee and lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to stand back up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright, your front heel down and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Squat down and put your hands on the floor, jump your feet back into a push-up position and do one push-up. Jump your feet back in toward your hands, stand up and jump, reaching your arms overhead.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight from head to heels in the push-up, and landing on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Bus Driver (Plate)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding a weight plate by its sides at about three and nine o'clock. Raise it in front of you to shoulder height, arms straight.

**Movement.** Turn the plate as far as you can to one side, like turning a steering wheel, then turn it as far as you can to the other side. A turn to both sides is one rep.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and at shoulder height, and your torso facing forward.

exercises.name: Butcher's Block Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel facing a bench, a little more than arm's length away. Rest your elbows on it about shoulder-width apart, bend your elbows and bring your palms together behind your head.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and let your chest sink toward the floor between your arms until you feel a stretch along your sides and the backs of your arms. Hold it for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows on the bench, your back flat and your head between your arms.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit with your back against the pad and set the seat so the handles are at chest height. Take a handle in each hand, arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Bring the handles together in front of your chest, then let them go back out until your hands are in line with your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Butterfly Sit-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a mat with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out to the sides. Lie back with your arms reaching overhead on the floor.

**Movement.** Swing your arms forward and sit all the way up, reaching your hands to touch your feet, then roll back down until your shoulders and hands touch the floor behind you.

**Keep steady.** The soles of your feet together and your knees out to the sides.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your knees bent out to the sides and the soles of your feet together, hands holding your feet or ankles.

**Movement.** Bring your heels as close to your hips as is comfortable and let your knees sink toward the floor until you feel a stretch along your inner thighs. Hold the stretch for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your back tall and the soles of your feet together.

exercises.name: Prone Prisoner Extension
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down with your legs straight and your fingers laced behind your head, elbows out to the sides on the floor.

**Movement.** Lift your head, chest and elbows off the floor as high as they go, drawing your elbows back, then lower back down.

**Keep steady.** Your feet and hips on the floor, your neck in line with your back and your hands resting on your head without pulling.

exercises.name: Back Pressure (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at chest height. Stand facing the cable, take the handle in one hand and bend that elbow to about a right angle in front of your body, palm facing you.

**Movement.** Draw your elbow back to pull the handle in toward your body, then let it return to the front. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow at the same angle and your wrist bent in toward you.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set two handles at chest height on a cable station. Stand between the stacks facing away, take a handle in each hand beside your chest and step forward into a split stance until the weights lift.

**Movement.** Press both handles forward until your arms are straight in front of your chest, hands close together, then let them come back until your hands are beside your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your torso leaning a little forward and still, your feet planted and your elbows just below shoulder height.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Decline Chest Press (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a cable above head height. Stand facing away from it in a split stance and take the handle in one hand beside your chest, elbow bent. Rest your other hand on your hip.

**Movement.** Press the handle forward and down until your arm is straight and your hand is in front of your lower chest, then let it come back beside your chest. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and facing forward, without twisting.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Incline Chest Press (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Stand facing away from it in a split stance and take the handle in one hand beside your chest, elbow bent. Rest your other hand on your hip.

**Movement.** Press the handle forward and up until your arm is straight and your hand is at about eye height, then let it come back beside your chest. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and facing forward, without twisting.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable and sit on a bench in front of it. Take the handle in one hand and rest the back of that upper arm against your inner thigh, arm straight.

**Movement.** Curl the handle up toward your shoulder, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm against your thigh and your torso still.

exercises.name: Cupping Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Sit facing it and rest one forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm up, wrist just past the edge, with the handle in that hand.

**Movement.** Let your wrist and fingers open toward the cable, then curl your fingers and wrist in toward you as far as they go. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your forearm on its support and your elbow still.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a cable at elbow height. Stand side-on to it and take the handle in your far hand, elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your side, forearm across your belly.

**Movement.** Turn your forearm out away from your body as far as your shoulder allows, then let it come back across your belly. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow against your side and bent to the same angle, and your torso still.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Chest Fly (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set both pulleys above head height. Take a handle in each hand and step forward between them, one foot ahead of the other, arms up and out to the sides with elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Sweep the handles down in a wide arc until they meet just below your chest, then let them rise back out along the same arc until your hands are about in line with your shoulders.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and leaning slightly forward, and the same small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Cable)
aliases: Cable Front Raise With a Small Bar
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a short straight bar to a low cable. Stand facing away from the machine with the cable between your legs and hold the bar with an overhand grip in front of your thighs, arms straight.

**Movement.** Raise the bar in front of you until your hands reach shoulder height, then lower it back to your thighs.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, without leaning back or swinging, and a small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Strap an ankle cuff to one ankle and attach it to a low cable. Face the machine, hold the frame and lean forward a little from the hips, standing on your other leg.

**Movement.** Push the cuffed leg back behind you, nearly straight, as far as your hip allows, then let it return forward under you. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still, your lower back not arching and your standing knee slightly bent.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lateral Raise (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Stand side-on to it and take the handle in your far hand, so the cable runs in front of your body, arm hanging straight.

**Movement.** Raise your arm out to the side until your hand reaches shoulder height, then lower it back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your body still, with no lean or swing, and a small bend in your elbow.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Press-Around (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a cable at chest height. Stand side-on to it with the cable behind your working arm, holding the handle beside your chest with your elbow bent.

**Movement.** Press and sweep the handle forward and across your body until your arm is straight and your hand is past the middle of your chest, then let it return beside your chest. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and facing forward, without twisting toward the handle.

exercises.name: Pull-Through (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a rope to a low cable. Face away from it, take an end of the rope in each hand between your legs and walk forward until the cable is taut, feet a little wider than your hips.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and let your hands travel back between your legs as your torso tips forward, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and your knees only slightly bent.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set both pulleys at shoulder height. Stand between them and cross your arms, taking the left cable in your right hand and the right cable in your left, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.

**Movement.** Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc until they are in line with your body, then let them return across in front of you.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, your arms nearly straight and your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Rear Delt Fly (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a cable at shoulder height. Stand side-on to it and take the handle in your far hand, arm straight out in front of you across your body.

**Movement.** Sweep your arm across and behind you in a big arc until it is in line with your body, then let it return across in front of you. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and square, a small bend in your elbow and your shoulder down.

exercises.name: Reverse Woodchopper (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a handle at the bottom of a cable. Stand side-on to it with your feet wider than your shoulders and your knees bent, and take the handle in both hands outside your near knee, arms straight.

**Movement.** Turn your shoulders and pull the handle up and across your body to above your far shoulder, standing up and pivoting on your back foot, then lower it back down the same way. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, and your hips turning with your shoulders.

exercises.name: Shrug-In (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of each of two cables. Stand between them, take a handle in each hand with your arms hanging at your sides, and stand where the cables pull slightly outward.

**Movement.** Lift your shoulders up and slightly in toward your ears as high as they go, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your head still and your body upright.

exercises.name: Side Pressure (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Fix a single handle to a cable at chest height. Turn so the machine is beside your working arm, take the handle and keep that upper arm against your ribs with the elbow bent at a right angle.

**Movement.** Drive your hand across in front of your chest toward your opposite hip, then let the cable bring it back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** The same elbow angle, your upper arm near your ribs and your shoulders square to the front.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Triceps Extension (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at about shoulder height. Stand side-on to the cable and take the handle in your far hand, so it starts at your opposite shoulder with your elbow bent in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Straighten your elbow to push the handle across your body and away from the cable until your arm is straight, then bend it to bring the handle back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm still at chest height and your torso turned a little toward the cable.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Face it, take the handle in one hand and hinge forward at your hips. Bring that upper arm back alongside your body, level with the floor, elbow bent.

**Movement.** Straighten your elbow to push the handle back until your arm is straight, then bend it to let the handle return. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm level with the floor and still, and your back flat.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Triceps Press (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the top of a cable. Stand facing away from it, take the handle in one hand and bring it to the front of your chest, elbow bent and out to the side.

**Movement.** Straighten your elbow to press the handle forward and down until your arm is straight, then bend it to bring the handle back to your chest. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow up and out to the side, and your torso still.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Fit a straight bar to a low cable. Stand close to the stack facing it and hold the bar against your thighs with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull the bar up along your body, elbows going out and up, until your upper arms are about level with your shoulders, then let it down until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows above your hands, your torso upright and your feet planted, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Woodchopper (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a handle at the top of a cable. Stand side-on to it with your feet wider than your shoulders and take the handle in both hands above your near shoulder, arms straight.

**Movement.** Turn your shoulders and pull the handle down and across your body to outside your far knee, pivoting on your back foot, then let it return along the same path. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and your hips turning with your shoulders.

exercises.name: Wrist Pronation (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle or strap at about waist height. Stand side-on to the cable and take it in one hand, elbow bent to a right angle at your side, so the cable turns your palm up.

**Movement.** Roll your forearm so your palm turns to face the floor, working against the cable's pull, then let the cable roll it back until your palm faces up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow at your side and your upper arm still, so only your forearm turns.

exercises.name: Wrist Supination (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle or strap at about waist height. Stand side-on to the cable and take it in one hand, elbow bent to a right angle at your side, so the cable turns your palm down.

**Movement.** Roll your forearm so your palm turns to face the ceiling, working against the cable's pull, then let the cable roll it back until your palm faces down. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow at your side and your upper arm still, so only your forearm turns.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise (Machine)
aliases: Calf Press Using Leg Press Machine
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the leg press and place your feet so only their balls rest on the bottom edge of the platform. Press the platform up until your legs are straight and release the safety handles.

**Movement.** Push the platform away by pointing your toes as far as they go, then let it come back until your heels drop past the edge.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight but not locked, and your back against the pad.

exercises.name: Hack Squat Calf Raise (Machine)
aliases: Calf Raise using Hack Squat Machine
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads. Put the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, heels hanging off, and release the safety.

**Movement.** Rise onto your toes as high as you can, then lower your heels below the edge.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight and your back against the pad.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one foot with its ball on the edge of a step and the heel hanging off, holding a wall or rail for balance. Bend the other leg up behind you.

**Movement.** Rise onto your toes as high as you can, then lower your heel below the step. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your standing knee straight and your body upright.

exercises.name: Calf Foam Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with a foam roller under your calves and your hands on the floor behind you, then lift your hips.

**Movement.** Push with your hands to roll back and forth from just above your ankles to just below your knees. Roll for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips off the floor and your toes pointing up.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in a captain's chair with your back against the pad, forearms on the arm pads and hands on the grips, then let your legs hang straight.

**Movement.** Bend your knees and lift them toward your chest until your thighs pass level with the floor, curling your hips up a little at the top, then lower your legs until they hang straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your upper body still, without swinging.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Oblique Knee Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in a captain's chair with your back against the pad, forearms on the arm pads and hands on the grips, then let your legs hang straight.

**Movement.** Bend your knees and lift them up and across toward one shoulder, turning your hips so your knees point to that side, then lower your legs until they hang straight. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your shoulders facing forward, without swinging.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders, your knees under your hips and your back flat.

**Movement.** Round your back up toward the ceiling, tucking your tailbone and letting your head drop. Then let your belly sink toward the floor, tilting your hips up and lifting your chest and head. Move between the two.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and your hands and knees in place.

exercises.name: Cat Plank
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders, your knees under your hips and your toes tucked under.

**Movement.** Lift your knees just off the floor and push the floor away so your upper back rounds up. Hold the position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your knees just off the floor, your hips level and your head in line with your back.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands beside your hips, fingers forward. Walk your feet out, knees bent, and slide your hips just off the bench so your straight arms hold your weight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor until your upper arms are about level with the floor, then press back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back close to the bench, your elbows pointing back and your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height. Sit with your back against the pad, feet flat, and take the handles.

**Movement.** Press the handles forward until your arms are straight, then let them come back until your hands are beside your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head against the pad and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the machine's foot plates and lie face down on its angled pad, chest on the pad and head just over the top. Take the handles with your arms hanging straight below your shoulders.

**Movement.** Pull the handles up toward your chest, elbows going back past your body, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the pad, your feet on the plates and your head in line with your back.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel with your big toes together and your knees about hip-width apart, sitting back toward your heels.

**Movement.** Fold forward to rest your belly on your thighs and your forehead on the floor, and reach your arms out in front with your palms down. Hold it for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips sinking back toward your heels and your hands in place on the floor.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your eyes looking straight ahead.

**Movement.** Draw your head straight back, sliding your chin back toward your neck without tipping it down, pause there, then let your head return to where it started.

**Keep steady.** Your eyes level, your shoulders still and your back upright.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing you, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still, without kicking or swinging.

exercises.name: Chin-Up Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Grip a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing you. Pull yourself up, or step up from a box, until your chin is over the bar.

**Movement.** Hold that top position, elbows fully bent and chin over the bar, for the set time, then lower to a straight-arm hang.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders down, your chin above the bar and your legs still.

exercises.name: Circle Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 45 degrees. Sit back with a dumbbell in each hand pressed straight overhead, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders, turn your palms up and press them forward in front of your chest until your arms are straight and the dumbbells meet. Then reverse the path: bring them back to your shoulders, turn your palms forward and press them overhead.

**Keep steady.** Your back on the bench, your feet flat and your wrists straight.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side with your head resting on your lower arm. Bend your hips and knees so your heels are in line with your back, knees stacked.

**Movement.** Keeping your feet together, lift your top knee as far as it goes without your hips rolling back, then lower it back down. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your feet together and your hips stacked one on top of the other.

exercises.name: Clamshell to Reverse Clamshell
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on one side, legs stacked, with both hips and knees bent and your head on your lower arm. Raise your whole top leg a little so it hovers above the bottom one.

**Movement.** Open your top knee upward while your feet stay level, close it, then lift your top foot upward while your knees stay level, and keep switching between the two. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips stacked and still and your top leg off the bottom one.

exercises.name: Clap Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower your chest to just above the floor, then push up hard enough that your hands leave the floor, clap them once, and land with your hands back in place and elbows slightly bent as you go into the next rep.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised.

exercises.name: Clean (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart. Squat down and grip it just outside your legs, arms straight, back flat and shoulders over the bar.

**Movement.** Stand up to lift the bar past your knees, then jump your hips forward and shrug to drive it up. Pull yourself under it into a front squat, catching it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high, then stand up.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your elbows high in the catch.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart. Bend your hips and knees and grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight, back flat.

**Movement.** Pull the bar off the floor and drive your hips and knees straight, dropping into a squat to catch it on your shoulders, then stand up. Dip your knees and drive the bar overhead, splitting your feet to drop under it on straight arms, then step your feet back in line.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your elbows high in the catch.

exercises.name: Clean and Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart. Bend at your hips and knees and take the bar just outside your legs, arms straight, back flat, chest up.

**Movement.** Lift the bar past your knees, then drive your hips forward and pull it up close to your body, dropping under it to catch it on your shoulders. Stand tall and press it overhead until your arms are straight, then lower it to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your torso upright as you press.

exercises.name: Clean Pull (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart. Bend down and grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight, back flat and shoulders over the bar.

**Movement.** Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees, then straighten your hips and knees fast, rise onto your toes and shrug your shoulders up. Lower the bar back to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, the bar close to your body and your back flat.

exercises.name: Neck Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and let your chin drop toward your chest.

**Movement.** Roll your head toward one shoulder, back, over to the other shoulder and down to your chest again in one smooth circle. Do the set number of circles clockwise, then the same counterclockwise.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders still and down, the movement coming from your neck only.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the pulldown with your thighs under the pads. Grip the bar with your hands a little inside shoulder-width, palms facing forward, arms straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the bar down in front of your face to your upper chest, elbows going down close to your sides, then let it rise until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright with only a slight lean back, and your thighs under the pads.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor a little narrower than your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest to just above your hands, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows close to your sides as they bend, and your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised.

exercises.name: Underhand Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the pulldown with your thighs under the pads. Take the bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing you, arms straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the bar down past your chin to your upper chest, elbows going down in front of your ribs, then let it rise until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright with no swing back and forth, and your thighs under the pads.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down with your legs straight, the tops of your feet on the floor and your hands flat under your shoulders.

**Movement.** Straighten your arms to lift your chest off the floor, letting your back arch, until you feel a stretch along your belly. Hold it for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and legs on the floor and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Commando Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand under a pull-up bar so it runs from your front to your back. Grip it with your hands close together, one in front of the other, palms facing each other, and hang with your arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your head passes one side of the bar, then lower until your arms are straight. On the next rep, bring your head up the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your body facing the same way throughout, without twisting, and your legs still.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side next to a bench with your forearm on the floor, elbow under your shoulder. Rest the inside of your top foot on the bench and let your bottom leg lie beneath it.
