**Movement.** Lift your hips until your body is straight from head to feet, the bottom leg raised to meet the bench. Hold the position for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and your hips stacked, not rolling forward or back.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your knees bent, lean back until your torso is at about 45 degrees and lift your feet a little off the floor. Clasp your hands in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Turn your shoulders to one side and touch your hands to the floor beside your hip, then turn to touch the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your feet off the floor, your back long and your chest up, your shoulders turning more than your knees.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about twice shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little, hands together in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee to sit down low over it, the other leg straight with its toes pointing up, then push back up through the middle. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** The heel of your bent leg on the floor, your chest up and your other leg straight.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel with your back to a bench or couch, one knee on the floor close to it and that shin resting up against or on it behind you. Step the other foot forward, flat on the floor.

**Movement.** Lift your torso upright and push your hips forward until you feel a stretch along the front of your back thigh and hip. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your lower back flat, not arching.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Y-Raise (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Stand side-on to it and take the handle in your far hand, so it starts in front of your opposite hip, arm almost straight.

**Movement.** Raise your arm up and across your body until it points up and out at an angle above your shoulder, one arm of a Y, then lower it back across your body. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and upright, without leaning away from the machine.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.

**Movement.** Curl one dumbbell up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, palm still facing in, lower it back to your side, then curl the other. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms close to your body and your torso still, without twisting.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand or sit tall. Bring one arm straight across the front of your chest at shoulder height.

**Movement.** Hook your other forearm under its elbow and pull the arm closer to your chest until you feel a stretch at the back of the shoulder. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your stretched shoulder down away from your ear and your torso facing forward.

exercises.name: Crossbody Hamstring Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with one foot crossed over in front of the other, feet close together and both flat on the floor.

**Movement.** Hinge forward from your hips and reach your hands toward the floor until you feel a stretch in the back of your rear leg. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your rear knee straight and both feet flat.

exercises.name: Lateral Leg Swing
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a wall or rack with both hands on it and your weight on one leg.

**Movement.** Swing your free leg across in front of your standing leg, then out to the side as far as it goes, and keep swinging back and forth. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso facing the wall and your standing leg still.

exercises.name: Crossover Triceps Extension (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the top of each of two facing cable stacks. Take the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left, and stand in the middle with your arms crossed in front of your face, elbows bent at about shoulder height.

**Movement.** Straighten your elbows to pull the handles out to the sides until your arms are straight, then bend them to bring your hands back across in front of your face.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms still at shoulder height and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, hands lightly behind your head or crossed on your chest.

**Movement.** Curl your head and shoulders up off the floor, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back on the floor and your hands not pulling on your head.

exercises.name: Crunch (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so the chest pad or handles sit at your upper chest. Sit with your feet under the foot pads or flat on the floor and take the handles.

**Movement.** Curl your torso forward and down, bringing your ribs toward your hips until you cannot curl further, then let the weight take you back up to sitting tall.

**Keep steady.** Your hips on the seat, and your arms only holding on, not pulling.

exercises.name: Crunch (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a rope to a high cable and kneel facing it. Hold the ends of the rope beside your head.

**Movement.** Curl your torso down, bringing your elbows toward your thighs, then rise back up.

**Keep steady.** Your hips still over your knees and your hands beside your head.

exercises.name: Vertical Leg Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back and raise your legs straight up so your feet point at the ceiling, legs together. Reach your arms up alongside your legs.

**Movement.** Curl your head and shoulders off the floor, reaching your hands up toward your toes, then lower your shoulders back down.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight and upright, and your lower back on the floor.

exercises.name: Cuban Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand against the fronts of your thighs, palms toward you, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull the dumbbells up until your elbows are level with your shoulders, forearms hanging down. Turn your forearms up until they point straight up, then press the dumbbells overhead. Reverse each step back to your thighs.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at shoulder height while your forearms turn, and your torso upright, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet a little wider than hip-width and hold one kettlebell by the sides of its handle with both hands, arms straight in front of your thighs.

**Movement.** Curl the kettlebell up toward your chest, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: High-Elbow Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an incline bench upright and stand or kneel behind it. Rest the back of one upper arm on the top of the pad so your elbow is about level with your shoulder, holding a dumbbell with that arm straight in front of you.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, then lower it until your arm is straight again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm on the pad and level with the floor, and your shoulder down.

exercises.name: Cycling
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the saddle so your knee is slightly bent with the pedal at its lowest point, then get on the bike.

**Movement.** Pedal in smooth circles for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips still on the saddle, your knees in line with your feet and your upper body relaxed.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your arms straight up over your shoulders and your hips and knees bent to right angles, shins level with the floor.

**Movement.** Lower one arm back over your head and straighten the opposite leg out until both are just above the floor, then bring them back to the start. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back pressed to the floor, and your other arm and leg still.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart. Bend at your hips and knees and grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight, back flat, shoulders slightly in front of the bar.

**Movement.** Push the floor away and stand up with the bar against your legs until your hips and knees are straight. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower it to the floor the same way.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Decline Leg Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench to a decline and lie face up on it with your head at the high end. Hold the handles or the bench behind your head and straighten your legs along the bench.

**Movement.** Lift your legs, keeping them straight, until they point up at the ceiling, then lower them until they are just above the bench.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back on the bench and your hands holding your upper body still.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench to a slight decline under a racked bar and hook your legs under the pads. Lie back with your eyes under the bar, grip it a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out over your chest, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your lower chest, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulder blades pulled back into the bench, your legs held under the pads and the bar over your lower chest.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench to a slight decline and hook your legs under the pads. Lie back with a dumbbell in each hand and press them up over your lower chest, arms straight, palms facing your feet.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your lower chest, then press them back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your legs held under the pads, your head on the bench and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on a low platform or a plate with the bar over the middle of your feet. Bend at your hips and knees and grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight, back flat.

**Movement.** Push the platform away and stand up with the bar against your legs until your hips and knees are straight. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower it until the plates touch the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Deficit Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set two sturdy blocks or push-up handles a little wider than your shoulders. Put a hand on each and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows until your chest drops past your hands, as deep as your shoulders allow, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and your elbows angled back from your sides.

exercises.name: Devil's Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell on the floor just outside each foot, handles parallel to your feet.

**Movement.** Squat down, grip both dumbbells, jump your feet back and lower your chest to the floor, then jump your feet back in. With the dumbbells between your feet, push your hips back and swing them up in one motion until your arms are straight overhead, then lower them to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat when you lift the dumbbells and your arms straight overhead at the top.

exercises.name: High-Incline Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an adjustable bench to a steep incline, about 60 degrees, under a racked bar. Sit back with your feet flat, grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out so it is over your shoulders, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your upper chest, just below your collarbones, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head on the bench, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor under your chest with your thumbs and index fingers touching to make a diamond shape, and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Let your elbows bend until your chest nearly touches your hands, then press back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and your elbows close to your sides.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Grip parallel bars and press up until your arms are straight and your body hangs between them.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows and lower yourself until your upper arms are about level with the bars, then press back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders down away from your ears and your legs still.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in a doorway. Bend one elbow to 90 degrees and put your forearm flat against the frame, elbow at about shoulder height.

**Movement.** Step forward with the leg on the same side until you feel a stretch across the front of your chest and shoulder. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your forearm on the frame, your shoulder down and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Double Clean and Press (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and two kettlebells on the floor between your feet. Push your hips back, bend your knees and grip a handle in each hand, back flat.

**Movement.** Hike the bells back, then drive your hips forward to stand and bring them up to rest on the outside of your forearms at your shoulders. Press them overhead until your arms are straight, lower them to your shoulders, then let them swing back down between your legs.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bells close to your body, and your body upright at the top, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a kettlebell in each hand in the rack position: handles at your collarbones, bells resting on the outsides of your forearms, elbows tucked in. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows in, your torso upright and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Double-Leg Abdominal Press
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face up on a mat and raise your legs so hips and knees form right angles, shins parallel to the floor. Rest your palms on the fronts of your thighs near the knees.

**Movement.** Drive your palms against your legs as your legs drive back against your palms, the two forces cancelling so nothing moves. Keep up this press for the set time, then relax.

**Keep steady.** Your head resting on the mat, the small of your back down and both knees held at right angles.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and your hands on a wall or rail in front of you for balance.

**Movement.** Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can, then lower your heels back to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight, your body upright and your weight even across both feet.

exercises.name: Drag Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a rope to a high cable. Stand facing it, hold an end in each hand and lean forward a little at the hips, with your elbows drawn back behind your body.

**Movement.** Push the rope down along the front of your body until your arms are straight and your hands are beside your hips, then let it rise until your forearms are level with the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows behind your body and still, and your torso at the same lean.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench and grip the bench, or a fixed post, behind your head. Lift your hips and legs until your body points up, resting on your upper back and shoulders.

**Movement.** Lower your body as one straight piece, pivoting at your shoulders, until it is just above the bench, then raise it back up until it points up again.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight from shoulders to toes, without bending at your hips, and only your upper back on the bench.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, hands on your hips or together in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Step one foot back and across behind the other, then bend both knees and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor. Push back up to standing. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and shoulders facing forward and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Face Pull (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your legs. Push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent, arms hanging straight.

**Movement.** Raise your elbows out to the sides and pull the dumbbells toward your face, turning your forearms so your hands finish beside your ears, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your torso still and your elbows at shoulder height at the top.

exercises.name: Curl to Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders, then press them overhead, turning your palms to face forward, until your arms are straight. Lower them back to your shoulders and then down to your sides.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, without leaning back or swinging.

exercises.name: Bradford Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at the front of your shoulders, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Press the dumbbells up just high enough to pass over your head and lower them to the back of your shoulders. Press them up again and bring them back down to the front. Each front and back press is one rep.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your elbows under your hands and your head still.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or plate and your heels hanging off.

**Movement.** Push up through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as they go, then lower them below the edge.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight, your body upright and your arms hanging still.

exercises.name: Cheat Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward, feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Lean forward a little at the hips, then drive your hips forward as you curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders, using that push to get them past the hardest point. Lower them back to your sides with your body upright.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the lean small and your elbows close to your sides.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a bench with your feet wide. Hold a dumbbell in one hand, lean forward a little and rest the back of that upper arm against your inner thigh, arm straight.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm against your thigh and your torso still.

exercises.name: Crunch (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face up, knees bent and feet flat, with one dumbbell held by its ends against your chest.

**Movement.** Curl your head and shoulders up off the floor until your shoulder blades lift, bringing your ribs toward your hips, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back on the floor and the dumbbell held against your chest.

exercises.name: Cyclist Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your heels raised on a wedge or plates, feet close together, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.

**Movement.** Bend your knees forward over your toes and sit straight down as deep as you can, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your heels on the wedge and your knees travelling forward over your toes.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and a dumbbell on the floor beside the outside of each foot. Bend your hips and knees and take the handles, arms straight, back flat.

**Movement.** Push the floor away and stand up until your hips and knees are straight, then push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the dumbbells to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and the dumbbells close to your legs.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Hold a light dumbbell in the crease behind one knee.

**Movement.** Keeping that knee bent, lift the leg until your thigh is level with your back and the sole faces the ceiling, then lower it back to the start. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips level and the dumbbell held firmly behind your knee.

exercises.name: Drag Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up along the front of your body, letting your elbows move back behind you, until they reach your lower chest. Lower them the same way until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The dumbbells close to your body and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand between two dumbbells, squat down and pick one up in each hand, then stand tall with them at your sides.

**Movement.** Walk forward with short, even steps for the set distance, then squat to put the dumbbells down.

**Keep steady.** Upright, your shoulders level and down, the dumbbells still at your sides.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat, a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, arms straight, palms facing your feet.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms rest on the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees from your sides, then press them back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your feet flat, your upper back on the floor and your wrists straight.

exercises.name: Frog Pump (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together close to your hips and your knees falling out to the sides. Hold a dumbbell across your hips with both hands.

**Movement.** Push through the outsides of your feet to lift your hips as high as they go, then lower them back to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your soles together, your knees out and your upper back on the floor.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, one end of each resting on the shoulder and your elbows pointing forward. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows up, your torso upright and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, hands cupping its top end. Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders, toes turned out a little.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down between your heels until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, the dumbbell against your chest and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Hang Power Clean (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in. Push your hips back to lower the dumbbells to just above your knees, back flat.

**Movement.** Straighten your hips and knees in one jump-like push and shrug, then pull yourself under the dumbbells to catch them on your shoulders in a quarter squat, and stand tall. Lower them to your sides.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the dumbbells close to your body and your elbows going up, then forward under them.

exercises.name: Hex Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, arms straight, palms facing each other, with the dumbbells pressed together side to side.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells together to your chest, keeping them in contact, then press them back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The dumbbells touching throughout, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench and a dumbbell across your hips, held at both ends. Bend your knees and plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, then lower your hips back toward the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your upper back on the bench, your chin down and your shins about upright at the top.

exercises.name: Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 45 degrees and sit back against it with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down behind your body, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head against the bench, and your upper arms hanging straight down and still.

exercises.name: Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Step forward with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to step back to standing. Alternate legs; each leg counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet together.

**Movement.** Take a long step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot and bring your back foot through into the next step. Alternate legs as you walk; each leg counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing back. Push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent, arms hanging straight below your shoulders.

**Movement.** Pull the dumbbells up and out with your elbows going wide until your upper arms are level with your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The same torso angle, your back flat and your elbows out to the sides, not back toward your hips.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Step back with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to bring the back foot forward to standing. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your front shin close to upright.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down. Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists are just past your knees.

**Movement.** Let your wrists bend down to lower the dumbbells, then lift the backs of your hands up as high as they go.

**Keep steady.** Your forearms on your thighs and your elbows still.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you, knees slightly bent.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and tip your torso forward, the dumbbells sliding down the front of your legs, until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the same small bend in your knees and the dumbbells close to your legs.

exercises.name: Scaption (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Raise the dumbbells forward and out at about 30 degrees from straight ahead, thumbs up, until your hands reach shoulder height, then lower them back to your sides.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still, your shoulders down away from your ears and the same small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: 90/90 Shoulder Rotation (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand. Raise your elbow out to the side to shoulder height and bend it to 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward and level with the floor.

**Movement.** Turn your forearm up until it points at the ceiling, then turn it back down until it is level again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow at shoulder height and bent to the same angle, and your body still.

exercises.name: Side Bend (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm facing in. Put your other hand on your hip or behind your head.

**Movement.** Bend sideways toward the dumbbell, sliding it down your leg as far as you can, then straighten back up and a little past upright toward the other side. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips still, bending only to the side, without leaning forward or back.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, hands cupping its top end, and stand with your feet together.

**Movement.** Take a wide step out to one side and sit your hips back over that foot, bending the knee while your other leg stays straight, then push off to step back to the start. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, both feet flat and pointing forward, and your bent knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one foot with its ball on the edge of a step and the heel hanging off, a dumbbell in the hand on that side and your other hand on a wall or rail. Bend your free leg up behind you.

**Movement.** Rise onto your toes as high as you can, then lower your heel below the step. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your standing knee straight, your body upright and the dumbbell hanging still.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench and a dumbbell resting on the hip of your working leg. Plant that foot flat and lift the other foot off the floor, knee bent.

**Movement.** Drive through your planted foot to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee, then lower them back toward the floor. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level, your upper back on the bench and your free foot off the floor.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Snatch (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell on the floor between them. Push your hips back, bend your knees and grip it with one hand, arm straight and back flat.

**Movement.** Drive through your legs and hips to stand up fast, pulling the dumbbell up close to your body, then punch it overhead and dip into a quarter squat to catch it on a straight arm. Stand, then lower it to the floor. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the dumbbell close to your body on the way up and your wrist straight overhead.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand in a long split stance, one foot well ahead of the other and your back heel lifted.

**Movement.** Bend both knees and lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push back up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your feet in place, your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in, and your feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are about level with the floor, the dumbbells hanging straight down beside your legs, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your arms hanging straight, your chest up, your whole foot on the floor and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, one dumbbell standing on end on the floor between your feet. Bend your knees out over your toes and hold its top end with both hands, arms straight, chest up.

**Movement.** Push your knees out and the floor away to stand up until your hips and knees are straight, then lower the dumbbell back to the floor the same way.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet well wider than your shoulders, toes turned out. Hold one dumbbell by its top end with both hands so it hangs straight down between your legs.

**Movement.** Bend your knees out over your toes and sit straight down until the dumbbell nearly touches the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your arms straight and your knees out in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Thruster (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in.

**Movement.** Squat down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand up hard and use that drive to press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight. Lower them to your shoulders as you go into the next squat.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your whole foot on the floor and the dumbbells over your shoulders at the top.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping its top end, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head, then straighten your arms to lift it back overhead.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms beside your head and still, your elbows pointing forward and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Ulnar Deviation (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with one arm straight down at your side, holding a dumbbell by one end of its handle, or one loaded at one end only, so the weighted end points behind you.

**Movement.** Tip your hand back at the wrist so the weighted end rises behind you, then let it come back down. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight and still at your side, so only your wrist moves.

exercises.name: Underhand Dead Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set two dumbbells on the floor and stand between them, feet about shoulder-width apart. Push your hips back with your knees slightly bent until your torso is close to level with the floor, and grip the dumbbells with your palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Pull the dumbbells up to the sides of your waist, elbows going back close to your body, then lower them until they rest on the floor before the next rep.

**Keep steady.** The same torso angle, your back flat and your hips still.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight and angled out so your hands are a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up and out toward the outsides of your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Tate Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, arms straight, palms facing your feet and the dumbbells end to end.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows out to the sides to lower the dumbbells in toward your chest, then straighten your arms to press them back up.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms still and your elbows pointing out to the sides.

exercises.name: Plank Jump-In
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a plank on your hands, hands under your shoulders, feet together and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Jump both feet in toward your hands so your knees come under your chest, landing on the balls of your feet, then jump them straight back out to the plank. Keep going for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hands planted under your shoulders and your hips low as you land back in the plank.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder, legs straight and feet stacked. Lift your hips so your body is straight from head to feet.

**Movement.** Lower your hips until they nearly touch the floor, then lift them back up until your body is straight again, or a little higher. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow under your shoulder and your body facing straight ahead, without rolling forward or back.

exercises.name: Freestyle Swim
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Push off the wall face down, arms stretched out ahead and legs together.

**Movement.** Reach and pull with one arm after the other while kicking your legs from the hips, turning your head to the side to breathe, for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Your body long and near the surface, rolling with each stroke.

exercises.name: Elbow Lever
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Squat down and put your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers turned out to the sides or back. Bend your elbows and set them into your belly on either side of your navel.

**Movement.** Lean forward onto your elbows and lift your feet off the floor, straightening your legs behind you until your body is level with the floor, balanced on your hands. Hold for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight and level from head to feet, and your elbows tucked into your belly.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, arms straight, palms facing each other.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest with your elbows close to your body, then press them back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows tucked in, your palms facing each other, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Elephant Walk
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet hip-width apart, fold forward from your hips and put your hands on the floor or on your shins.

**Movement.** Press one knee straight while letting the other bend, until you feel a stretch behind the straight knee, then switch which knee is straight, like walking on the spot. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hands down, your torso folded and both heels on the floor.

exercises.name: Elevated Hamstring Stretch
aliases: Standing Hamstring Stretch on a Bench
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a bench or box at about knee to hip height and put one heel up on it, that leg straight with the toes up.

**Movement.** Fold forward from your hips over the raised leg until the back of that thigh pulls. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Both knees straight, your back flat and your hips square to the bench.

exercises.name: Elliptical
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Step onto the pedals one foot at a time, take the moving handles in both hands and set the resistance and program on the console.

**Movement.** Drive the pedals round in a smooth oval stride, pushing one handle and pulling the other in time with your legs. Keep going for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Upright, your whole foot on each pedal, without leaning your weight on the handles.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with one leg straight. Loop a band over the top of that foot and anchor the other end low in front of you, so it pulls your toes away from you.

**Movement.** Pull your toes back toward your shin against the band as far as they go, then let them return. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your leg straight and still, with the movement only at your ankle.

exercises.name: Ankle Plantarflexion (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with one leg straight. Loop a band around the ball of that foot and hold both ends in your hands, arms bent, so the band is taut.

**Movement.** Point your toes away from you against the band as far as they go, then let them come back toward you. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your leg straight on the floor and your hands still.

exercises.name: Exhale and Body Position Drill
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Start at the wall in the pool.

**Movement.** Swim one length at an easy pace, breathing out into the water between breaths, and rest at the wall before the next.

**Keep steady.** Your body long and flat near the surface, your neck relaxed.

exercises.name: Explosive Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower your chest to just above the floor, then push up hard enough that your hands leave the floor. Land with your hands back in place and your elbows slightly bent, and go straight into the next rep.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised.

exercises.name: Seated External Rotation (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor and bend one knee up, foot flat. Rest the elbow on that side on top of the knee, bent to 90 degrees, a dumbbell in your hand and your forearm pointing forward.

**Movement.** Turn your forearm up until it points at the ceiling, then lower it back until it points forward again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow on your knee, your shoulder down and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Lat Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a rack upright or door frame and grip it at about hip height with one hand, your feet close to its base.

**Movement.** Sit your hips back and shift them out to the side of the gripping arm until that arm is straight and you feel the stretch down that side of your back. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight, your hand in place and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Extreme Pec Stretch (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Open your arms out to the sides until your hands are a little below the bench and you feel a deep stretch across your chest. Hold that position for the set time, then bring the dumbbells back up.

**Keep steady.** The same small bend in your elbows, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold an EZ bar on the outside of its bends with an overhand grip. Bring it up to the front of your shoulders and stand tall, feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Press the bar straight up, moving your head back a little to let it pass, until your arms are straight overhead. Lower it back to your shoulders.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight and your body upright, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Anchor a band at about face height. Hold it with both hands, palms facing down, and step back until your arms are straight in front of you and the band is taut.

**Movement.** Pull the band toward your face, spreading your hands so they finish beside your ears with your elbows high, then let it go back until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Upright, without leaning back, and your elbows at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a rope on a cable at about face height. Hold an end in each hand, palms facing down, and step back until your arms are straight in front of you.

**Movement.** Pull the rope toward your face, spreading the ends so your hands finish beside your ears with your elbows high, then let it go back until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Upright, without leaning back, and your elbows at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Fat Grip Hold (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put thick grips on the handles of two dumbbells. Pick one up in each hand and stand tall with your arms straight at your sides.

**Movement.** Hold the dumbbells there for the set time, then set them down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your shoulders down and the handles still in your hands.

exercises.name: Assisted Straight-Bar Support Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a straight bar in a rack at about hip height. Stand facing it and grip it with your hands about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Press down to straighten your arms and lift your chest over the bar, keeping your feet on the floor behind you to take some of your weight, then hold that position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your shoulders pushed down away from your ears and your body still.

exercises.name: Fingertip Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders, spread your fingers and lift your palms so you rest on your fingertips. Step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your palms off the floor, your fingers spread and your body in one straight line.

exercises.name: 20 mm Edge Hang
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Reach up to a fingerboard and set the pads of your fingers on a 20 mm edge, hands about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Lift your feet so you hang with your arms straight. Hold the hang for the set time, then step back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your shoulders pulled down rather than hanging loose, and your fingers in the same grip on the edge.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.

**Movement.** Lift one bent leg out to the side and draw big circles with that knee, forward for some reps, then backward. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips level and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Tyler Twist
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand the flexible bar upright in your working hand with that wrist bent back. Take the top of the bar in your other hand, palm facing away, and bend that wrist to twist the bar.

**Movement.** Keeping the twist, straighten both arms out in front so the bar lies level. Let your working wrist bend forward as the bar unwinds, then return to the start. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight in front and your other hand keeping the twist.

exercises.name: Resistance Bar Wrist Extension
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit with one forearm resting on your thigh or a table, palm down, your wrist just past the edge. Hold one end of a flexible bar in that hand and the other end in your other hand.

**Movement.** Bend the bar by lifting the back of your working hand as far as it goes, then let the wrist drop back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your forearm on its support and your elbow still.

exercises.name: Resistance Bar Wrist Flexion
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit with one forearm resting on your thigh or a table, palm up, your wrist just past the edge. Hold one end of a flexible bar in that hand and the other end in your other hand.

**Movement.** Bend the bar by curling your working wrist up as far as it goes, then let it drop back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your forearm on its support and your elbow still.

exercises.name: Floor Dip
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat. Put your hands on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing forward, and press up until your arms are straight and your hips are off the floor.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor, then straighten your arms to press back up.

**Keep steady.** Your hips off the floor, your elbows pointing back and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Slider Hamstring Curl
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and your heels on sliders or towels on a smooth floor, arms at your sides. Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.

**Movement.** Slide your heels away until your legs are almost straight, then pull them back toward your glutes.

**Keep steady.** Your hips up throughout and your upper back and arms on the floor.

exercises.name: Floor Skull Crusher (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat. Hold an EZ bar over your chest with an overhand grip on the angled parts, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the bar back past your head until it rests on the floor, then straighten your arms to bring it back over your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms angled back a little and still, and your lower back on the floor.

exercises.name: Flutter Kick
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides. Lift your heels a few inches off the floor.

**Movement.** Kick your legs up and down in small strokes, one rising as the other lowers, without letting either touch the floor. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight, your lower back on the floor and your upper body still.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set both pulleys at shoulder height. Take a handle in each hand and step forward between them, one foot ahead of the other, arms out to the sides with elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a wide arc, then let them open back out along the same arc until your hands are about in line with your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and leaning slightly forward, and the same small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until the dumbbells are about level with your chest, then bring them back up over your chest along the same arc.

**Keep steady.** The same small bend in your elbows, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench to a slight decline and hook your legs under the pads. Lie back with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until the dumbbells are about level with your chest, then bring them back up over your chest along the same arc.

**Keep steady.** The same small bend in your elbows and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Adductor Foam Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down on your forearms. Bend one knee out to the side and set a foam roller beneath the inside of that thigh, lying parallel to your body.

**Movement.** Shift your body sideways to roll from just above your knee up toward your groin and back. Roll for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your forearms on the floor and your hips facing the floor.

exercises.name: Shin Foam Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with a foam roller under the front of your shins, just below your knees, and your hands on the floor.

**Movement.** Walk your hands forward and back to roll along your shins down to your ankles and back. Roll for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your toes pointing back and your back flat.

exercises.name: Glute Foam Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a foam roller with your hands on the floor behind you. Cross one ankle over the other knee and lean toward the side of the crossed leg.

**Movement.** Roll back and forth over that glute, from the top of your thigh to the top of your hip. Roll for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your planted foot flat and your weight on the crossed leg's side.

exercises.name: IT Band Foam Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side and set a foam roller beneath the outer thigh of your bottom leg, forearm on the floor and top foot planted in front of you.

**Movement.** Push with your arm and top foot to roll from just above your knee up to your hip and back. Roll for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your body on its side and your bottom leg straight.

exercises.name: Quad Foam Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down on your forearms with a foam roller under the front of both thighs.

**Movement.** Pull and push with your arms to roll from just above your knees up to your hips and back. Roll for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight like a plank and your forearms under your shoulders.

exercises.name: Forward Arm Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms straight at your sides.

**Movement.** Swing your straight arms back and up past your ears, then forward and down past your hips in one big circle. Keep circling the same way; each full circle is a rep.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your body upright and your lower back still.

exercises.name: Frog Stand
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Squat down with your feet close together and your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers spread. Bend your elbows a little and rest your knees on the backs of your upper arms.

**Movement.** Lean forward onto your hands until your feet lift off the floor, balancing on your hands with your knees resting on your arms. Hold for the set time, then put your feet back down.

**Keep steady.** Your head up, looking ahead, and your weight over your hands.

exercises.name: Frog Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours on a mat, then slide your knees out wide, shins straight back behind them and the insides of your feet on the floor. Drop onto your forearms.

**Movement.** Ease your hips back toward your heels until you feel a stretch along your inner thighs. Hold the stretch for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your knees, hips and ankles on one line.

exercises.name: Front Lever
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms straight.

**Movement.** Keeping your arms straight, pull the bar down toward your hips and raise your body until it is straight and level with the floor, face up. Hold for the set time, then lower your legs back to a hang.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and your body in one line from shoulders to feet, hips not dropping.

exercises.name: Front Lever Row
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart and raise your body into a front lever: straight, level with the floor, face up, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows and pull your chest up toward the bar, keeping your body level, then straighten your arms to lower back into the lever.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight and level the whole time, your hips not dropping.

exercises.name: Tuck Front Lever
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, and pull your knees in close to your chest.

**Movement.** With your arms straight, press the bar down toward your hips and tip your body back until your back is level with the floor and facing up, knees still tucked. Hold it there for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your back level and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Front Neck Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck. Hold it for the set time, then bring your head back upright.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders down, your back upright and the bend coming from your neck only.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Front Raise (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Stand facing away from the machine with the cable between your legs, holding the handle in one hand in front of your thigh, arm straight.

**Movement.** Raise the handle in front of you until your hand reaches shoulder height, then lower it back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, without swinging, and a small bend in your elbow.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body, arms straight.

**Movement.** Raise the dumbbells in front of you until your hands reach shoulder height, then lower them back to your thighs.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright without leaning back or swinging, a small bend in your elbows, and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Plate)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding a weight plate by its sides at about three and nine o'clock, arms straight, the plate in front of your thighs.

**Movement.** Raise the plate in front of you until it reaches shoulder height or just above, then lower it back to your thighs.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright without leaning back or swinging, and a small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Front Split Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on a mat and step one foot forward, then straighten that leg out in front of you with the heel on the floor. Put your hands on the floor or on blocks either side of your hips.

**Movement.** Slide your front heel forward and your back knee back, lowering your hips toward the floor as far as you can go. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your hips square to the front and your back leg straight behind you, kneecap down.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the bar in a rack at shoulder height. Step in so it rests on the front of your shoulders against your neck, fingers under the bar just outside your shoulders, elbows high. Stand up to lift it off, step back and set your feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit straight down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows high, your torso upright and your whole foot on the floor.

exercises.name: Sit-Out
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get on your hands and feet with your knees just off the floor, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.

**Movement.** Lift one hand and turn your hips toward that side, threading the opposite leg under your body and out straight in front of you. Bring it back, put your hand down and go the other way. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your supporting hand under your shoulder and your hips off the floor.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart, arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, then lower them back to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your upper back and feet on the floor, and your knees in line with your feet.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Bridge Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, a dumbbell in one hand. Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, and press the dumbbell up over your chest.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor, elbow angled out from your side, then press it back up until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips up and level, without tipping toward the dumbbell.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the machine with your upper back against the back pad and the belt or pad across your hips. Put your feet flat on the platform about hip-width apart, knees bent.

**Movement.** Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your upper back against the pad, your chin down and your shins about upright at the top.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the glute-ham developer so your knees sit just behind the pad and your feet press against the plate under the rollers. Start with your body straight and level with the floor, face down.

**Movement.** Bend your knees to pull your body up until it is upright from knees to head, then lower back until it is level with the floor again.

**Keep steady.** Your hips straight and your body in one line from knees to head.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the machine so the foot plate or pad sits against your working foot or the back of that knee. Rest your chest or forearms on the pad and hold the handles, standing on your other leg.

**Movement.** Push the plate back and up by straightening your hip until your thigh is in line with your body, then let it return forward. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still on the pad and your lower back not arching.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, knees slightly bent and your hands behind your head.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and tip your torso forward until it is close to level with the floor or you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your elbows out and the same small bend in your knees.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads, feet about shoulder-width apart. Release the safety handles.

**Movement.** Bend your knees and hips to lower until your thighs are at least level with the platform, then push back up.

**Keep steady.** Your back and hips against the pad, your whole foot down and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders with your palms still facing in, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight, without swinging.

exercises.name: Wrist Levering (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Load a dumbbell handle at one end only. Stand with one arm straight at your side, holding the handle near its free end with the weighted end pointing forward.

**Movement.** Tip your hand up at the wrist to raise the weighted end in front of you as far as it goes, then let it come back down. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight and still at your side, so only your wrist moves.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a rope to a low cable. Stand facing it and hold an end in each hand, palms facing each other, arms straight.

**Movement.** Curl the rope up toward your shoulders with your palms still facing each other, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so the handles are level with your lower chest. Sit with your back against the pad, feet flat, and take the handles.

**Movement.** Press the handles forward and down until your arms are straight, then let them come back until your hands are beside your lower chest.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head against the pad and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Hamstring Choke
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat. Lift one knee toward your chest and hold the back of that thigh with both hands.

**Movement.** Straighten that knee to push the foot toward the ceiling until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh, then bend it again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your thigh held still close to your chest and your head down.

exercises.name: Hamstring Foam Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with a foam roller under the backs of your thighs and your hands on the floor behind you, then lift your hips.

**Movement.** Push with your hands to roll from just above your knees up to your glutes and back. Roll for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips off the floor and your legs straight.

exercises.name: Straight-Leg Kick
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall, feet about hip-width apart, arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.

**Movement.** Kick one leg up straight in front of you toward your hands, then lower it and kick the other. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your kicking leg straight, your standing foot flat and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Gripper Squeeze
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a hand gripper in one hand with one handle across the base of your fingers and the other against your palm, near the base of your thumb.

**Movement.** Close your hand until the handles touch, or as far as they go, then let them open until your fingers are almost straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your wrist straight and your arm relaxed at your side.

exercises.name: Handstand
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a clear patch of floor. Put your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers spread, and kick one leg up and then the other.

**Movement.** Bring your legs together over your hips and balance upside down on straight arms, shifting your weight through your fingers to stay up. Hold it for the set time, then step down one leg at a time.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line from hands to toes, your arms straight and your shoulders pushed up toward your ears.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart, a hand's length from a wall, and kick up into a handstand with your heels resting on the wall, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor, then press back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight, your heels on the wall and your elbows in rather than flared out.

exercises.name: Hang Clean (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand holding the bar at your thighs, hands just outside your legs and arms straight, feet about hip-width apart. Push your hips back to lower it to just above your knees.

**Movement.** Straighten your hips and knees fast and shrug to drive the bar up your body, then pull yourself under it into a front squat, catching it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high. Stand up.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your elbows high in the catch.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand holding the bar at your thighs with a wide grip, hands far outside your shoulders and arms straight, feet about hip-width apart. Push your hips back to lower it to just above your knees.

**Movement.** Straighten your hips and knees fast to send the bar up close to your body, then pull yourself under it into a squat, catching it overhead on straight arms. Stand up, then lower it.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your arms straight in the catch.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, arms straight and legs together.

**Movement.** Lift your legs in front of you, keeping them straight, until they are at least level with the floor, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your upper body still, without swinging.

exercises.name: Happy Baby
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back and draw your knees up toward your armpits, knees wide. Take hold of the outsides of your feet, soles facing the ceiling.

**Movement.** Pull your feet down a little so your knees sink toward the floor beside your ribs. Hold the stretch for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your head down, your lower back flat to the floor and your shins upright.

exercises.name: Head Tilt
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your head level.

**Movement.** Tilt your head to bring one ear toward that shoulder, pause there, then bring your head back upright and tilt to the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders down and level, and your face pointing forward without turning.

exercises.name: Head Turn
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and down, your arms at your sides and your eyes looking straight ahead.

**Movement.** Turn your head to one side as far as it goes, so your chin moves toward your shoulder, then turn back through the middle to the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your chin level and your shoulders still, so only your head turns.

exercises.name: Heel Touch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, a little wider than hip-width. Lift your head and shoulders off the floor, arms straight at your sides.

**Movement.** Bend to one side to reach your hand toward that heel, then bend to the other side to reach the other heel. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your head and shoulders off the floor and your lower back down, bending sideways without twisting.

exercises.name: Helms Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench to a low incline and stand behind its top end. Lean forward to rest your chest on the top of the pad so your torso is close to level with the floor, a dumbbell in each hand hanging straight down.

**Movement.** Pull the dumbbells up to the sides of your ribs, elbows going back, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the pad, your legs still and your shoulders not lifting toward your ears.

exercises.name: Hercules Hold (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a handle at about hip height on each of two facing cable stacks. Take one in each hand and step into the middle until both cables pull your arms out to the sides.

**Movement.** Hold the handles with your arms straight and a little out from your body for the set time, then let them return.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your torso upright and your hands level, without being pulled to either side.

exercises.name: High-Pulley Lateral Raise (Cable)
aliases: Lateral Rows on Cable, One Armed
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a cable at about waist height. Stand side-on to it and take the handle in your far hand, palm facing in, so the cable runs across the front of your body.

**Movement.** Lift your hand out sideways to shoulder height, then let it come back across your body. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, with no lean or swing, and a small bend in your elbow.

exercises.name: High-Incline Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an incline bench at about 45 to 60 degrees under a Smith machine bar so the bar lines up with your upper chest. Sit back with your feet flat, grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and unhook it with your arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head on the bench, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: High Knee Skip
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall at the start of a clear stretch of floor or track, feet hip-width apart and arms bent at your sides.

**Movement.** Skip forward, driving one knee up to hip height as the other foot hops off the floor, then switch legs on the next skip. Swing your arms opposite to your legs and keep going for the set distance.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, landing on the balls of your feet under your hips.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent at your sides.

**Movement.** Run in place, driving each knee up to about hip height and landing on the ball of the foot, switching legs fast and pumping your arms with them. Keep going for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, without leaning back, and your feet landing under your hips.

exercises.name: High Plank
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor under your shoulders and step your feet back, about hip-width apart, so you are on your hands and toes with your arms straight and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Hold this position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and your shoulders over your hands.

exercises.name: High Pull (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, holding the bar with an overhand grip just wider than your shoulders. Push your hips back and bend your knees slightly so the bar hangs just above your knees.

**Movement.** Drive your hips forward and stand up fast, then keep the bar moving up close to your body with your elbows leading high and out until it reaches your chest. Lower it back to above your knees.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your elbows above your hands.

exercises.name: Single-Arm High Row (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a high cable. Kneel on one knee a step back from the machine, the other foot flat in front, and take the handle in the hand on the side of your down knee, arm reaching up and forward.

**Movement.** Pull the handle down and back to the side of your ribs, elbow going back past your body, then let it go back until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and square to the machine, without twisting.

exercises.name: Hindu Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Start in a push-up position with your hands a little wider than your shoulders and your feet about hip-width apart, then push your hips up and back so your body makes an upside-down V.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward close to the floor, then straighten your arms and lift your chest so your hips end low and your back arches. Push your hips back up to the V to finish.

**Keep steady.** Your hands and feet in place, your legs straight and your hips off the floor.

exercises.name: Hindu Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms out in front of you.

**Movement.** Swing your arms back as you squat down, letting your heels rise until you are low on your toes with your hands beside your heels, then stand back up as your arms swing forward again.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your back straight through the squat.

exercises.name: Hip Airplane
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg with that knee slightly bent and tip forward from your hips until your torso and free leg are close to level with the floor, arms out to the sides.

**Movement.** Turn your hips and chest open to the side of your free leg as far as they go, then turn them back down until they face the floor again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your standing knee still and pointing forward, and your back flat.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall beside a wall or rack with one hand on it and your weight on the leg nearer the support.

**Movement.** Lift your outside knee up in front of you, open it out to the side, then bring it down and back in so it draws a big circle, then circle the other way. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, and your standing leg straight.

exercises.name: Hip Crossover
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and together, and your arms out to the sides.

**Movement.** Let both knees fall over to one side toward the floor, then bring them back up and over to the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Both shoulders and arms on the floor and your knees together.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.how_to:
