**Setup.** Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat on the floor a long step in front, your hands on your hips.

**Movement.** Tuck your pelvis under and ease your hips forward until the front of your back hip pulls. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back and stand with your feet about hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and tip your torso forward until it is close to level with the floor, or as far as your back stays flat, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar fixed on your upper back and the same small bend in your knees.

exercises.name: Lateral Walk (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Loop a mini band around your legs just above your knees or ankles. Stand with your feet hip-width apart so it is taut, then bend into a quarter squat.

**Movement.** Step sideways with one foot, then follow with the other just far enough to keep the band taut, moving across the floor. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** The same quarter squat, your toes forward and your torso still, without rocking side to side.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench and a padded bar across your hips. Bend your knees and plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, then lower your hips back toward the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your upper back on the bench, your chin down and your shins about upright at the top.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on a mat with your arms straight overhead and your legs straight and together.

**Movement.** Lift your arms, head, shoulders and legs off the floor so only your lower back stays down and your body curves like a shallow bowl. Hold for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back pressed into the mat, and your arms and legs straight.

exercises.name: Wall Chest Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand side-on to a wall. Reach your near arm out to the side and put your palm flat on the wall at shoulder height, arm straight.

**Movement.** Turn your feet and body away from the wall until you feel a stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulder. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hand on the wall, your arm straight and your shoulder down away from your ear.

exercises.name: Horse Stance
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about twice shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little, hands in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Bend your knees and sink until your thighs are about level with the floor. Hold the position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your knees out over your toes and your weight even across both feet.

exercises.name: Hub Lift (Plate)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand beside a weight plate lying flat with its hub facing up, or a plate on a loading pin. Bend down and grip the hub between your thumb and fingertips.

**Movement.** Stand up with the plate hanging at your side. Hold it there for the set time, lower it, then switch hands.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight, your back flat as you lift and the plate clear of the floor.

exercises.name: Y-W Back Extension (Plate)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set yourself on a back extension bench, pad under your hips and heels under the rollers. Hold a light plate in each hand and let your upper body hang down.

**Movement.** Raise your torso until your body is straight and pull your arms back into a W, elbows bent and below your shoulders. Lower, then rise again and reach your arms overhead into a Y. One W and one Y count as one rep.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight at the top, not arching past it.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the pad of a back extension bench just below your hips and hook your heels under the rollers. Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper body hang down from your hips.

**Movement.** Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line from head to heels, then lower it back down as far as your hips allow.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your body straight at the top, without arching past it.

exercises.name: Ice Cream Maker
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart and pull yourself up until your chest is at the bar.

**Movement.** Push the bar away as you tip back, straightening your arms and raising your legs until your body is level with the floor in a front lever. Then pull back up into the top of the pull-up.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight from shoulders to feet and your legs together, without kicking.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an incline bench at about 30 to 45 degrees under a racked bar. Lie back with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat. Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out so it sits over your shoulders, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your upper chest, just below your collarbones, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulder blades pulled back into the bench, your hips down and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 30 to 45 degrees. Sit with the dumbbells resting on your thighs, lie back and press them up over your chest, palms facing your feet.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest, then press them back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head on the bench, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an incline bench at about 30 degrees under a Smith machine bar so the bar lines up with your upper chest. Lie back with your feet flat, grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and unhook it with your arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your upper chest, just below your collarbones, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulder blades pulled back into the bench, your hips down and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Incline Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an incline bench in front of a high cable, facing the machine. Lie face down on it with your chest on the pad and take a straight bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, arms straight above your head.

**Movement.** Pull the bar down and back toward the top of your chest, elbows going down to your sides, then let it go back until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the pad and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Incline Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at a low incline and lie face down on it with your chest on the pad, a dumbbell in each hand hanging below your shoulders, palms facing in, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Raise your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until they are level with your body, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the pad, the same small bend in your elbows and your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 45 degrees. Lie face down on it with your chest on the pad and your head just over the top, a dumbbell in each hand hanging straight below your shoulders.

**Movement.** Pull the dumbbells up to the sides of your ribs, elbows going back, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the pad, your shoulders down and your head in line with your back.

exercises.name: Incline Close-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
aliases: Incline Close Grip Barbell Bench Press
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an incline bench at about 30 degrees under a racked bar. Lie back with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat. Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart and lift it out over your shoulders, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your upper chest with your elbows close to your sides, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows tucked in, your shoulder blades pulled back and your hips on the bench.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench to a decline and lie back on it with your head at the low end, feet hooked under the pads and hands lightly behind your head.

**Movement.** Curl your head, shoulders and upper back up off the bench toward your knees, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back on the bench and your hands not pulling on your head.

exercises.name: Incline Y-Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 45 degrees and lie face down on it, chest on the pad, feet on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down, thumbs pointing up.

**Movement.** Raise your arms forward and out in a Y shape until they are in line with your body, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the pad, your arms nearly straight and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 30 to 45 degrees. Lie back with a dumbbell in each hand above your upper chest, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until the dumbbells are about level with your chest, then bring them back up over your chest along the same arc.

**Keep steady.** The same small bend in your elbows, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Incline Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 45 degrees. Sit back with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows angled partway out to the sides.

**Movement.** Press the dumbbells up over your head until your arms are straight and the dumbbells meet, then lower them until your elbows are about level with your shoulders.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head on the bench and your feet flat.

exercises.name: Swiss Ball Plank Toe Tap
aliases: Incline Plank With Alternate Floor Touch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put the tops of your feet on a Swiss ball and walk your hands out into a plank, hands under your shoulders and your body straight from head to feet.

**Movement.** Lift one foot off the ball and move it out to the side to tap the floor, then bring it back onto the ball. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and in line with your body, and the ball still under your other foot.

exercises.name: Incline Skull Crusher (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 45 degrees and sit back against it, a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight up above your shoulders, palms facing each other.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head, then straighten your arms to press them back up.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms still and pointing up, and your elbows in.

exercises.name: Incline Press Hold (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 30 to 45 degrees. Sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh, then bring them up as you lie back and press them over your upper chest, palms facing your feet.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells about halfway, so your elbows are a little above the bench, and hold them still there for the set time. Then press them back up.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head on the bench, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bar in a rack at about hip height. Lie under it and grip it a little wider than your shoulders, arms straight, heels on the floor and body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Pull your chest up to the bar, elbows going back, then lower until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised.

exercises.name: Pronation Hold (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel or sit beside a bench and rest one forearm on it, thumb side up. Grip a dumbbell near one end of its handle, or use one loaded at one end only, so the weight sits above your hand.

**Movement.** Let the weighted end tip out until your palm has turned partway up, then stop it. Hold it there for the set time, then switch hands.

**Keep steady.** Your forearm on the bench and your elbow still, so only your forearm works.

exercises.name: Squat Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms out in front of you.

**Movement.** Squat down until your thighs are about level with the floor and stay there. Hold the position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your whole foot on the floor and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Isometric Wiper
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend one elbow to lower your chest toward that hand, shift across to the other hand while staying low, then push back up to the middle with both arms straight. Each pass from one side to the other is one rep.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and your hips level, without twisting.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl Hold (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in one hand. Rest that forearm on your thigh, palm up, so your wrist is just past your knee.

**Movement.** Curl your wrist up as far as it goes. Hold the dumbbell there for the set time, then lower it and switch hands.

**Keep steady.** Your forearm on your thigh and your elbow still.

exercises.name: Wrist Rising Hold (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with one arm straight down at your side, holding a dumbbell by one end of its handle, or one loaded at one end only, with the weighted end pointing forward.

**Movement.** Tip the weighted end up as far as your wrist allows. Hold it there for the set time, then lower it and switch hands.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight and still at your side, so only your wrist works.

exercises.name: JM Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench under a racked bar and grip it a little narrower than shoulder-width. Lift it out and hold it over your chest, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows and let the bar travel down and back toward your chin, forearms tipping back, until it is just above your upper chest. Press it back up the same way until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows pointing toward your feet, your shoulder blades pulled back and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a handle of the rope in each hand with the rope behind your heels, feet together, elbows close to your sides and hands just out from your hips.

**Movement.** Turn the rope over your head with your wrists and jump just high enough for it to pass under your feet, landing on the balls of your feet. Keep jumping for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows near your sides, your body upright and your knees slightly bent as you land.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Jump your feet out wider than your shoulders as you swing your arms out and up overhead, then jump your feet back together as your arms come back down.

**Keep steady.** Light on the balls of your feet, your arms straight and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunge
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in a lunge, one foot well ahead of the other, both knees bent and your back knee just off the floor.

**Movement.** Jump straight up, switch your legs in the air and land in a lunge with the other foot in front, knees bent, going straight into the next jump. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes on every landing.

exercises.name: Jumping Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Place a box under a pull-up bar if you need it, so that standing you can reach the bar with your elbows bent. Grip it a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.

**Movement.** Jump up and pull with your arms in one move until your chin clears the bar, then lower yourself until your arms are straight and put your feet back down.

**Keep steady.** Your body under the bar, your legs together and no swing on the way down.

exercises.name: Kegel
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face up, knees bent and feet flat, or sit tall on a chair, your belly, glutes and thighs loose.

**Movement.** Lift and tighten the muscles at the floor of your pelvis, the ones that hold in pee, and hold them there for the set time. Then let them go fully before the next one.

**Keep steady.** Your belly, glutes and thighs loose, with only the pelvic floor working.

exercises.name: Kelso Shrug (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench to a low incline and lie face down on it with your chest on the pad. Hold a barbell below you with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull your shoulder blades back and together, lifting the bar a few inches without bending your elbows, then let them spread apart again.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your chest on the pad and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor between your ankles. Push your hips back, bend your knees and grip the handle with both hands, arms straight, back flat.

**Movement.** Push the floor away and stand up until your hips and knees are straight, then push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the kettlebell to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and the kettlebell close between your legs.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold one kettlebell by the sides of its handle, bell down, close to your chest. Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders, toes turned out a little.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down between your heels until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, the kettlebell against your chest, your heels down and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg with that knee slightly bent, holding a kettlebell in the hand opposite your standing leg, arm straight.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and tip your torso forward as your free leg rises behind you, lowering the kettlebell toward the floor until your body and back leg are close to level, then return to standing. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and square to the floor, your back flat and the kettlebell under your shoulder.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, a kettlebell on the floor between your feet. Bend your knees out over your toes and grip the handle with both hands, arms straight, chest up.

**Movement.** Push your knees out and the floor away to stand up until your hips and knees are straight, then lower the kettlebell back to the floor the same way.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Sumo High Pull (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, a kettlebell on the floor between them. Push your hips back, bend your knees out over your toes and grip the handle with both hands, back flat.

**Movement.** Stand up in one push and pull the kettlebell up close to your body until your hands are under your chin, elbows high and out. Lower it to arm's length, then to the floor as you sit back.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Swing (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet a little wider than hip-width and a kettlebell on the floor a step in front of you. Push your hips back, grip the handle with both hands and tip it toward you.

**Movement.** Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward to stand tall and let it swing up to about chest height on straight arms. Let it fall back between your legs as you push your hips back again.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your arms straight, the swing coming from your hips.

exercises.name: Thruster (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a kettlebell in each hand in the rack position: handles at your collarbones, bells on the outsides of your forearms, elbows tucked in. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Squat down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand up hard and use that drive to press both kettlebells overhead until your arms are straight. Bring them back to the rack for the next squat.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows in during the squat, your chest up and the kettlebells over your feet at the top.

exercises.name: Windmill (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a kettlebell straight overhead in one hand. Stand with your feet wider than your hips and turn both feet about 45 degrees toward your free side.

**Movement.** Push your hips out toward the kettlebell side and bend sideways at the hips, sliding your free hand down the inside of your free-side leg toward the floor, then come back up to standing. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your weighted arm straight and pointing at the ceiling, and your eyes on the kettlebell throughout.

exercises.name: Wrist Turnover (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel or sit beside a bench and rest one forearm on it, hand past the edge. Hold a kettlebell by its handle with the bell hanging below, palm facing in.

**Movement.** Turn your forearm to rotate your palm down, then turn it back the other way until your palm faces up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your forearm on the bench and your elbow still, so only your forearm turns.

exercises.name: Kickboard Kick
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down in the water with your arms stretched out ahead, hands resting on the far end of a kickboard.

**Movement.** Kick your legs up and down from the hips in small, quick kicks for the set distance or time, lifting your head to breathe.

**Keep steady.** Your legs nearly straight and your hips near the surface.

exercises.name: Kickstand Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a barbell in front of your thighs, hands about shoulder-width apart. Set one foot slightly behind the other with only its ball on the floor, most of your weight on the front leg, knees slightly bent.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and tip your torso forward, the bar sliding down the front of your leg, until you feel a stretch in the front leg's hamstring, then drive your hips forward to stand tall. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips square and your back foot only for balance.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on the floor and put your hands down a little wider than your shoulders. Walk your hands forward until your body is straight from head to knees, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line from head to knees, and your elbows angled back from your sides.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, arms straight and legs together.

**Movement.** Bend your knees and lift them toward your chest until your thighs pass level with the floor, curling your hips up a little, then lower your legs until they hang straight.

**Keep steady.** Your upper body still, without swinging.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with both legs straight and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Bend one knee and pull it toward your chest with both hands wrapped around your shin until you feel a stretch in your glute and lower back. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your other leg flat on the floor and your head down.

exercises.name: Kneeling Glute Kickback
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.

**Movement.** Push one foot back and straighten that leg until it is in line with your body, then bring the knee back under your hip. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips square to the floor and your lower back not arching.

exercises.name: Bird Dog Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, back flat.

**Movement.** Reach one arm straight forward and the opposite leg straight back until both are level with your back, and hold them there for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips level and your neck in line with your back.

exercises.name: Kroc Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put one hand on a bench, feet staggered with the opposite foot back, and lean forward until your torso is a little above level. Hold a dumbbell in your free hand, arm straight below your shoulder.

**Movement.** Pull the dumbbell up to the side of your waist, letting your torso rise a little, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your hips still, with only your upper body moving a little.

exercises.name: L-Sit
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your legs straight and together and your hands flat beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.

**Movement.** Press down through straight arms to lift your hips and legs off the floor, your legs held straight out in front at about hip height. Hold for the set time, then sit back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms and legs straight, your shoulders pushed down away from your ears and your toes pointed.

exercises.name: Foot-Supported L-Sit
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your legs straight and together and your hands flat beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.

**Movement.** Press down through straight arms to lift your hips off the floor, leaving your heels down in front of you so they carry part of your legs' load. Hold for the set time, then sit back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms and legs straight and your shoulders pushed down away from your ears.

exercises.name: L-Sit Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, and lift your straight legs in front of you until they are level with the floor.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight and level with the floor throughout, without kicking or swinging.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Landmine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Load the free end of a barbell set in a landmine. Stand facing it with your feet about hip-width apart and hold the end of the bar in both hands at the top of your chest, elbows bent.

**Movement.** Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight, then lower it back to your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, without leaning back, and your legs straight.

exercises.name: Rotation (Landmine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a barbell in a landmine and stand facing it, feet wider than your shoulders. Hold the free end in both hands at arm's length in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Turn your shoulders and swing the end of the bar down in an arc to beside one hip, pivoting on your back foot, then bring it back up through the middle and down to the other hip. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your arms nearly straight and your hips turning with your shoulders.

exercises.name: Squat to Press (Landmine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Wedge a barbell's end into a landmine and stand facing the loaded end, feet a little wider than your shoulders. Hold the end of the bar with both hands at your chest.

**Movement.** Squat down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand up and press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight. Bring it back to your chest as you go into the next squat.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your elbows under the bar at the bottom and your heels down.

exercises.name: Larsen Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench under a racked bar with your eyes under it. Straighten your legs out past the end of the bench and lift your feet just off the floor. Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out over your chest.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your mid-chest, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your feet off the floor, your legs straight and your hips and shoulder blades on the bench.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the pulldown with your thighs under the pads. Take the bar with your hands wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward, arms straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the bar down in front of your face to your upper chest, elbows leading, then let it rise until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright with no swing back and forth, your thighs under the pads.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Single-Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
aliases: Lat Pulldown - Cross Body Single Arm
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Fit a single handle to the pulldown. Sit turned at an angle so only one thigh is under the pad, and reach across your body to take the handle with the opposite hand, arm straight.

**Movement.** Pull the handle down and across toward the side of your chest, elbow going down to your hip, then let it rise back across until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright at the same angle, without twisting toward the handle.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown Hold (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the pulldown with your thighs under the pads and take the bar with your hands wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Pull the bar down to your upper chest and hold it there, elbows down by your sides, for the set time, then let it rise until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright and still, and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Lateral Bound
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg with the knee and hip bent a little and the other foot just off the floor.

**Movement.** Push off sideways and jump across to land on the other foot, sinking into the landing and settling your balance before jumping back. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your landing knee in line with your toes and your chest up.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Hold (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your hands reach shoulder height, then hold them there for the set time and lower them back to your sides.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your shoulders down away from your ears and the same small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Raise your arms out to the sides until your hands reach shoulder height, then lower them back to your sides.

**Keep steady.** Your body still, with no lean or swing, and the same small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Lateral-to-Front Raise (Dumbbell)
aliases: Shoulder Raise Side and Front DB
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, sweep them forward until they are in front of you at the same height, then lower them to your thighs. Start each rep from your sides.

**Keep steady.** Your arms nearly straight at shoulder height as they sweep, and your torso still.

exercises.name: Lateral Walk
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, then bend your hips and knees into a quarter squat with your hands in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Step sideways with one foot, then bring the other after it to hip-width again, staying low. Each step is one rep. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your knees bent, your toes pointing forward and your hips level, without bobbing up and down.

exercises.name: Lean-Away Lateral Raise (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Stand side-on to it with your feet close to the machine, grip the upright with your near hand and let your body tip away until that arm is straight. Take the handle in your far hand.

**Movement.** Lift your hand out sideways to shoulder height, then lower it back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** The same lean, your body still and a small bend in your elbow.

exercises.name: Leg Curl (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Anchor a band low in front of you and loop the other end around one ankle. Lie face down with your legs straight, far enough away that the band is taut.

**Movement.** Bend your knee to curl your heel toward your glutes against the band, then lower it until your leg is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and thighs on the floor.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down on the machine with your knees just past the edge of the bench and the pad against the back of your ankles. Hold the handles.

**Movement.** Bend your knees to curl the pad up toward your glutes, then lower it until your legs are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your hips down on the bench.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit with your back against the pad and your knees lined up with the machine's pivot, the lower pad behind your ankles and the thigh pad on your thighs.

**Movement.** Bend your knees to push the pad down and back under the seat, then let it return until your legs are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your thighs under their pad.

exercises.name: Standing Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand at the machine with the front of your thigh against the pad and the lower pad behind the ankle of your working leg. Hold the handles.

**Movement.** Bend your knee to curl the pad up toward your glutes, then lower it until your leg is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your thigh against the pad and your hips and torso still.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit with your back against the pad and set it so your knees line up with the machine's pivot. Hook your ankles under the lower pad and hold the handles.

**Movement.** Straighten your knees to lift the pad until your legs are straight, then lower it until your knees are bent again.

**Keep steady.** Your back and hips against the seat.

exercises.name: Isometric Leg Extension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the leg extension machine with your back against the pad, your knees lined up with its pivot and your ankles under the lower pad. Hold the handles.

**Movement.** Straighten your knees to lift the pad until your legs are straight, or to the angle you choose, and keep it there. Hold the position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your back and hips against the seat and the pad still.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the leg press with your back and hips against the pad. Put your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart, press it up and release the safety handles.

**Movement.** Bend your knees to lower the platform until your knees come close to your chest, then press it back up until your legs are almost straight.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and lower back on the pad, and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Narrow-Stance Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the leg press with your back and hips against the pad. Put your feet in the middle of the platform a few inches apart, toes forward, then press it up and release the safety handles.

**Movement.** Bend your knees to lower the platform until your knees come close to your chest, then press it back up until your legs are almost straight.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and lower back on the pad and your knees pointing the same way as your toes.

exercises.name: Wide-Stance Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the leg press with your back and hips against the pad. Put your feet high on the platform, wider than your shoulders and turned out a little, then press it up and release the safety handles.

**Movement.** Bend your knees to lower the platform until your knees come down beside your chest, then press it back up until your legs are almost straight.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and lower back on the pad and your knees out over your toes.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on a mat with your legs straight and together. Put your hands at your sides or under your hips, or hold something solid behind your head.

**Movement.** Lift your legs, keeping them straight, until they point up at the ceiling, then lower them until your heels are just above the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back on the mat and your legs straight.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in a captain's chair with your back against the pad, forearms on the arm pads and hands on the grips, then let your legs hang straight and together.

**Movement.** Lift your legs in front of you, keeping them straight, until they are at least level with the floor, then lower them until they hang straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your upper body still, without swinging.

exercises.name: Leg Swing
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand side-on to a wall or rack with one hand on it and your weight on the leg nearer the support.

**Movement.** Swing your outside leg forward and up, then back behind you, and keep swinging in an easy arc that grows a little each time. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your standing leg straight.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your arms at your sides and raise your legs straight up toward the ceiling, knees and feet together.

**Movement.** Draw small circles in the air with your feet, both legs moving together as one. Make the same number of circles in one direction, then the other.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back and hips on the floor and your legs pressed together.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest. Sit with your back against the angled pad, feet flat, and take the handles.

**Movement.** Press the handles up and forward until your arms are straight, then let them come back until your hands are beside your upper chest.

**Keep steady.** Your back and head against the pad and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall. Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side, put your other hand behind your back, and rest the hand on the turned side on the back of your head.

**Movement.** Lower your nose toward that armpit, letting your hand add a light pull, until you feel the stretch along the back and side of your neck. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders level and the shoulder on the stretched side down.

exercises.name: Long Lunge Pulse Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a band overhead between your hands, arms straight and pulling it apart. Step one foot forward into a long lunge and drop until your back knee is just above the floor.

**Movement.** Pulse your hips a little down and up, staying low in the lunge. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight overhead, your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.

exercises.name: Wide-Stance Box Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a box behind you low enough that your thighs are below level when seated. Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back, step back and set your feet well wider than your shoulders, toes turned out a little.

**Movement.** Send your hips back and sit onto the box, settle fully on it, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your shins close to upright and your knees out over your toes.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Chest Fly (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set both pulleys at the bottom. Take a handle in each hand and step forward between them, one foot ahead of the other, arms down and out to the sides with elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Bring the handles up and together in front of your upper chest in a wide arc, then let them lower back out along the same arc until your hands are about level with your hips.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, and the same small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Lunge with Twist Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Step one foot forward into a long lunge and lower your back knee to the floor, hands on your front thigh.

**Movement.** Turn your chest toward your front leg, bringing your arms with it, and sink your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of your back hip and through your side. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your front knee over your ankle and your hips facing forward.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.

**Movement.** Step forward with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to step back to standing. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Lying Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on a flat bench high enough that your arms can hang straight down past its sides, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, then lower them until your arms hang straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms hanging straight down and still, and your back and head on the bench.

exercises.name: Lying Figure-Four Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat. Cross one ankle over the other knee.

**Movement.** Lift your lower foot off the floor and draw that thigh toward your chest with your hands behind it until the glute of the crossed leg pulls. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your head down, your lower back flat and the crossed knee turned out.

exercises.name: Incline Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at a steep incline and lean your chest against it, feet on the floor behind, a dumbbell in each hand. Bring your elbows back beside your body so your upper arms are about level with the floor, elbows bent.

**Movement.** Straighten your arms to push the dumbbells back until your arms are straight, then bend your elbows to let them return.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the bench and your upper arms level and still.

exercises.name: High Row (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so the handles are above and in front of your head. Sit facing the machine with your thighs under the pad and take the handles, arms reaching up and forward.

**Movement.** Pull the handles down and back until your hands are beside your chest, elbows going back past your body, then let them go back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your thighs under the pad and your torso still, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and the pads against the outsides of your knees, legs together. Hold the handles.

**Movement.** Push your knees out to the sides as far as they go, then let them come back together.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your hips on the seat.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivots. Sit with your chest against the pad and put your upper arms against the arm pads, elbows bent, holding the handles.

**Movement.** Raise your arms out to the sides until your elbows reach shoulder height, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still against the pad and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down on the machine's pad with your hips at its edge and hold the handles. Hook your ankles behind the roller or into the strap, legs hanging down.

**Movement.** Swing both legs up behind you with your knees straight until they are in line with your body, then let them lower back under the pad.

**Keep steady.** Your chest and hips on the pad and your upper body still.

exercises.name: Jog in Place
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent at your sides.

**Movement.** March in place, lifting each knee in turn and swinging the opposite arm, or pick up the pace into a light jog on the balls of your feet. Keep going for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your feet landing under your hips.

exercises.name: High Knee March
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Lift one knee up in front of you as high as it goes, swinging the other arm forward, then put the foot down and lift the other knee. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, without leaning back, and your standing leg straight.

exercises.name: Meadows Row (Landmine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a barbell in a landmine and load its free end. Stand side-on to that end in a staggered stance, hinge forward and rest your free forearm on your front knee. Grip the end of the bar overhand with your near hand, arm straight.

**Movement.** Pull the bar up toward your hip, elbow going up and back past your body, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your hips still and your shoulders level, without twisting.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Booklet Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your legs straight and a medicine ball held in both hands above your chest, arms straight.

**Movement.** Sit your torso up as you pull your knees in toward your chest, bringing the ball to meet your shins like a book closing. Lower your back and straighten your legs to return, heels and shoulders just above the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, and your lower back on the floor as you open out.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor under your shoulders and step your feet back so you are on your hands and toes, arms straight, body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs in one quick move, bringing that foot back as the other knee comes in, and keep running your knees in turn. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders over your hands and your hips low, level with your shoulders.

exercises.name: Muscle-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up fast and high, bringing the bar toward your lower chest, then lean forward and turn your wrists over the bar so your elbows come above it. Press up until your arms are straight above the bar, then lower back the same way to a hang.

**Keep steady.** Your legs together and your body close to the bar as you go over it.

exercises.name: Neck Half Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and let your head tilt toward one shoulder.

**Movement.** Roll your head down and forward until your chin is near your chest, then on up to the other shoulder, and back again the same way, staying in front without tipping your head back.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders still and down, the movement coming from your neck only.

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and down, arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Tilt your head to bring one ear toward that shoulder, then rest the hand on that side on top of your head and let its weight draw your head a little further. Hold the stretch for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your other shoulder down, your face pointing forward and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Decline Sit-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench to a decline and sit on it facing the high end with your feet hooked under the pads. Lie back with your arms crossed on your chest.

**Movement.** Curl your torso up off the bench, one part of your back at a time, until your chest is close to your thighs, then lower back down until your shoulders touch the bench.

**Keep steady.** Your feet hooked in and your head in line with your spine, without throwing your arms.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Fit a wide bar with parallel handles to the pulldown and sit with your thighs under the pads. Take the handles with your palms facing each other, arms straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the handles down in front of your face to your upper chest, elbows going down and back, then let them rise until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright with no swing back and forth, and your thighs under the pads.

exercises.name: No-Push-Up Burpee
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Squat down and put your hands on the floor in front of your feet, jump your feet back so your arms are straight and your body is in one line, then jump them back in toward your hands. Stand up and jump, reaching your arms overhead.

**Keep steady.** Your hips neither sagging nor raised when your feet are back, and landing on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down under a bar, a heavy object or a partner's hands, your body upright from knees to head.

**Movement.** Lean forward as one straight line, lowering yourself toward the floor as far as you can hold, then catch yourself with your hands, push off and pull with your hamstrings to come back upright.

**Keep steady.** Your hips straight and your body in one line from knees to head.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Bent-Over Row (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Take it in one hand, step back, and push your hips back until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent, free hand on your knee, arm straight toward the pulley.

**Movement.** Pull the handle to the side of your waist, elbow going back past your body, then let it go forward until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your shoulders square to the floor.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
aliases: One Arm Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Stand with your back to the machine, take the handle in one hand and lift it overhead so the cable runs behind you, arm straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbow to lower the handle behind your head, then straighten your arm to lift it back overhead. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm beside your head and still, and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a push-up position with your feet wider than your shoulders and one hand on the floor under your chest, the other hand behind your back.

**Movement.** Bend your elbow to lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight and your hips and shoulders level, without twisting toward the floor.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Bicep Curl (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a kettlebell in one hand by its handle, arm straight at your side, palm facing forward and the bell hanging below your hand.

**Movement.** Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow at your side and your upper arm still, without leaning or swinging your body.

exercises.name: Open Book
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side with your knees bent up to hip height, your head on a cushion, and your arms straight out in front of you, palms together.

**Movement.** Lift your top arm and open it up and over toward the floor behind you, turning your chest and head to follow it, then bring it back to meet the bottom hand. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your knees together on the floor and your hips stacked as your upper body turns.

exercises.name: High Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set both pulleys at shoulder height with a handle on each. Stand in the middle and take a handle in each hand, palms up, arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to curl the handles in toward the sides of your head, then straighten your arms back out.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms level with the floor and still, and your body upright.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a rope to a cable at chest height. Hold an end in each hand, turn away from the machine and step forward into a split stance, hands behind your head and elbows pointing forward.

**Movement.** Straighten your arms to press the rope forward and up until your arms are straight, then bend your elbows to bring it back behind your head.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms beside your head and still, and your torso still.

exercises.name: Overhead Press Hold (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the bar in a rack at upper-chest height. Grip it just wider than your shoulders, step under so it rests on the front of your shoulders, and step back with your feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Press the bar up to about the height of your forehead and stop it there, then hold it still for the set time before lowering it back to your shoulders.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight, your body upright without leaning back and the bar level.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a barbell overhead with a wide grip and straight arms, standing with your feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** The bar over the middle of your feet, your arms straight and your chest up.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a bench and hold an EZ bar overhead with a narrow overhand grip on the angled parts, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, then straighten your arms to lift it back overhead.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms beside your head and still, your elbows pointing forward and your back upright.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a handle on a cable at chest height. Stand side-on to it, step out until the cable is taut and hold the handle in both hands against the middle of your chest, feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Press the handle straight out in front of your chest until your arms are straight, then bring it back to your chest. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders and hips facing forward, without letting the cable turn you toward it.

exercises.name: Support Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand between parallel bars and put a hand on each, palms facing in.

**Movement.** Press down to lift your body off the floor until your arms are straight. Hold yourself there for the set time, then step back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your shoulders pushed down away from your ears and your legs still.

exercises.name: Paused Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench under a racked bar with your eyes under it and your feet flat. Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out over your chest, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bring the bar down until it touches your chest, stop it there for a short pause without letting it sink or bounce, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulder blades pulled back, your hips on the bench and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Pause Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height. Step under so it rests across your upper back, grip it just outside your shoulders, stand up to lift it off and step back, feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, stop there and stay still for a moment, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit facing the pec deck with your chest against the pad and the handles set to the back. Take the handles with your arms straight out in front at shoulder height.

**Movement.** Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc until they are in line with your body, then let them return to the front.

**Keep steady.** Your chest against the pad, your arms nearly straight and your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet. Push your hips back and bend your knees until your torso is level with the floor, and grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders, arms straight, bar on the floor.

**Movement.** Pull the bar off the floor to your lower chest in one quick pull, then lower it back to the floor and let it settle before the next rep.

**Keep steady.** Your torso level with the floor the whole time, your back flat and your hips not rising.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Step into the pendulum machine with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads, feet in the middle of the platform about shoulder-width apart. Release the safety.

**Movement.** Bend your knees to let the pad swing down and back until your knees are deeply bent, then push through your feet to drive it back up.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad, your whole foot down and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Rear Delt Row (Landmine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand at the free end of a loaded landmine bar with your body turned side-on to it. Hinge forward a little at the hips, knees slightly bent, and grip the bar just behind the plates with the nearer hand, arm straight.

**Movement.** Pull the bar up with your elbow going out to the side until your upper arm is level with your shoulder, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** The same hip hinge, your back flat and your torso square, without twisting.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** From all fours, bring one knee forward behind that hand and lay the shin across the floor in front of you, foot toward the other hip. Slide the other leg straight back.

**Movement.** Lower your hips toward the floor and fold your chest over your front shin until you feel a stretch deep in the front leg's glute. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your hips square to the front and your back leg straight, kneecap down.

exercises.name: Pike Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart and your feet behind you, then walk your feet in and lift your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V, legs straight.

**Movement.** Press your hands into the floor so your shoulders reach toward your ears and your head sits between your arms, then hold that position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms and legs straight, your hips high and your back flat.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V, arms straight and hands a little wider than your shoulders.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your hips high, your legs straight and your head in line with your arms.

exercises.name: Pin Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a flat bench in a rack and set the pins so the bar rests a few inches above your chest. Lie under the bar with your eyes under it, feet flat, and grip it a little wider than your shoulders.

**Movement.** Press the bar off the pins until your arms are straight, then lower it back until it rests on the pins and stops, and press again from there.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulder blades pulled back, your hips on the bench and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Pin Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the pins in a rack at about chin height and rest the bar on them. Stand under it with your feet about hip-width apart and grip it just wider than your shoulders.

**Movement.** Press the bar off the pins until your arms are straight overhead, then lower it until it rests back on the pins and stops, and press again from there.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight and your body upright, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Pin Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the safety pins of a rack at the depth you want to stop at. Take the bar from the rack onto your upper back, hands just outside your shoulders, and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Squat down until the bar settles on the pins, let it rest there for a moment, then stand back up with it.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg with the other leg straight out in front of you, foot just off the floor, and your arms reaching forward at shoulder height.

**Movement.** Bend your standing knee and sit down as low as you can go, then stand back up on the same leg. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your free leg off the floor, your standing heel down and your knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Planche Lean
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor under your shoulders, fingers turned out a little, and step your feet back so you are on your hands and toes, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lean your body forward on your toes until your shoulders are well in front of your hands, push the floor away so your upper back rounds slightly, and hold that position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your body in one line from head to heels and your hips level.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down, then lift yourself onto your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.

**Movement.** Hold your body in a straight line from head to heels for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level, neither sagging nor raised, and your neck in line with your back.

exercises.name: Plank Jack
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a plank on your hands, hands under your shoulders, feet together and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Jump both feet out wide, then jump them back together, like a jumping jack in a plank. Keep going for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and in line with your body, and your hands planted under your shoulders.

exercises.name: Plank Reach
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a plank on your hands, hands under your shoulders, feet hip-width apart and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Lift one hand and reach that arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height, then put the hand back down. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and your shoulders square to the floor, without rocking toward the lifted arm.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a plank on your hands, hands under your shoulders and feet a little wider than hip-width, your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Lift one hand and touch it to the opposite shoulder, then put it back down. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and still, without rocking side to side as each hand lifts.

exercises.name: Plank Up-Down
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a plank on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders, feet hip-width apart and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Put one hand on the floor under its shoulder, then the other, and press up into a plank on your hands. Lower back down one forearm at a time, the same arm first. Lead with the other arm next. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and in line with your body, without rocking side to side.

exercises.name: Plank Leg Lift
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set up in a plank on your hands or forearms, body straight from head to heels, feet hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Lift one leg with the knee straight until it is about in line with your body, then lower it and lift the other. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, your hips level and not twisting.

exercises.name: Ankle Plantarflexion Stretch (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with one leg straight. Loop a band over the top of that foot, anchor its ends to something low ahead of you and slide back until it is taut.

**Movement.** Point your toes away from you and let the band draw the top of your foot forward and down until you feel a stretch along the front of your ankle and shin. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your leg straight and relaxed on the floor.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Lat Pulldown (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so your thighs fit under the pads and sit down. Reach up and take the handles, arms straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the handles down in an arc to your upper chest, elbows going down and back, then let them rise until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your thighs under the pads and your body still.

exercises.name: Pinch Hold (Plate)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand two smooth plates together with their flat sides out. Pinch them between your thumb on one side and your fingers on the other, and stand tall with your arm straight at your side.

**Movement.** Hold the plates there for the set time, then set them down and switch hands.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight, your shoulders level and the plates clear of your leg.

exercises.name: Posterior Pelvic Tilt
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart, arms resting at your sides.

**Movement.** Rock your pelvis back so your tailbone curls up a little and the small of your back comes down to the floor, then let it roll back to where it started.

**Keep steady.** Your hips on the floor, without lifting into a bridge, and your upper body loose.

exercises.name: Power Clean (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart. Bend down and grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight, back flat, shoulders over the bar.

**Movement.** Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees, then straighten your hips and knees fast and shrug so the bar rises up your body. Drop under it into a shallow squat, elbows turning forward to catch it on the front of your shoulders, and stand up. Lower it to the floor.

**Keep steady.** The bar close to your body all the way, your back flat.

exercises.name: Power Snatch (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart. Bend at your hips and knees and take a wide grip, hands far outside your shoulders, arms straight, back flat.

**Movement.** Pull the bar past your knees, then straighten your hips and knees fast to drive it up close to your body. Drop into a quarter squat to catch it overhead on straight arms, thighs above level, then stand up and lower it.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your arms locked overhead.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl Hold (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms on the pad and your armpits at its top edge. Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip on the angled parts.

**Movement.** Curl the bar up until your elbows are bent at about a right angle. Hold it there for the set time, then lower it.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms on the pad, your elbows at the same angle and your shoulders still.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat height so the top of the pad sits in your armpits with the backs of your upper arms along it. Grip the handles underhand, arms almost straight.

**Movement.** Curl the handles up toward your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are almost straight.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms on the pad and your chest against it.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms on the pad and your armpits at its top edge. Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip on the angled parts, arms almost straight.

**Movement.** Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, then lower it until your arms are almost straight.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms on the pad and your shoulders still.

exercises.name: Prisoner Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, fingers laced behind your head and elbows pointing out to the sides.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows back, your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Prone T Raise
aliases: Prone Scapular Retraction - Arms at Side
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down with your forehead on a folded towel, your legs straight and your arms straight out to the sides in a T, thumbs pointing up.

**Movement.** Pull your shoulder blades together to lift your arms off the floor as high as they go, pause, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your forehead on the towel and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor beside your waist, fingers turned out, and step your feet back so you are on your hands and toes, arms straight. Lean forward until your shoulders are in front of your hands.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight, keeping the forward lean.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders in front of your hands throughout, your body in one straight line and your elbows close to your sides.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on a box under a pull-up bar and grip it a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away. Step up until your chin is over the bar, elbows fully bent.

**Movement.** Lift your feet clear of the box and stay in that top position for the set time, then lower to a straight-arm hang or step back down.

**Keep steady.** Your chin above the bar, your shoulders down and your legs still.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still, without kicking or swinging.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from the parallel handles of a pull-up station, palms facing each other and about shoulder-width apart, arms straight and feet off the floor.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is over your hands, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still, without kicking or swinging, and your shoulders down away from your ears at the top.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the counterweight, then kneel on the pad or stand on the platform and take the top handles a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is over your hands, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright and still on the pad, without kicking or leaning back.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about one and a half times shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up, elbows going down and out to your sides, until your chin is over the bar, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still, without kicking or swinging, and your chest facing the bar.

exercises.name: Pullover (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor. Hold one dumbbell over your chest with both hands cupping its top end, arms straight with a small bend in the elbows.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbell back over your head in an arc until your upper arms are about in line with your body, then bring it back over your chest along the same arc.

**Keep steady.** The same small bend in your elbows, your hips on the bench and your lower back not arching.

exercises.name: Pullover (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot. Sit with your back against the pad, fasten the belt if there is one, and rest your elbows on the arm pads with your hands on the bar above your head.

**Movement.** Drive your elbows down and forward in an arc until the bar reaches your belly, then let them rise back over your head.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your hands light on the bar, the push coming from your elbows.

exercises.name: Fingerboard Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from the edges of a fingerboard with your hands about shoulder-width apart, the pads of your fingers on the edge, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is level with the board, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your fingers in the same grip on the edge and your legs still, without kicking.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with one foot a half step ahead of the other, knees slightly bent, hands up in loose fists by your chin.

**Movement.** Throw straight punches, one hand after the other: turn your shoulder and hip into each one, reach until your arm is almost straight, then bring the fist straight back to your chin. Keep going for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hands back by your chin between punches and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Push Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the bar in a rack at upper-chest height. Grip it just wider than your shoulders, step under so it rests on the front of your shoulders, and step back with your feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Dip a short way by bending your knees, then drive up through your legs and use that push to press the bar straight overhead until your arms are straight. Lower it back to your shoulders.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright in the dip, with your knees moving forward rather than your hips back.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and your elbows angled back from your sides.

exercises.name: Push-Up Rotation
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Do a push-up, then at the top turn your body to one side and lift that arm toward the ceiling until you face sideways on one hand. Bring the arm back down, do the next push-up and turn to the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line as you turn, without your hips dropping.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your feet on a bench behind you and your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders, arms straight, body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and your elbows angled back from your sides.
