exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the edge of a bench a little wider than your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the edge of the bench, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and your elbows angled back from your sides.

exercises.name: Quad Set
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit or lie on a mat with your legs straight in front of you and a small rolled towel under one knee.

**Movement.** Tighten the front of that thigh to press the back of your knee down into the towel, stay there for a moment, then relax. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your heel on the floor and your other leg relaxed.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg next to a wall, resting one hand on it.

**Movement.** Bend your other knee and take that ankle in your free hand, then draw your heel toward your glutes until you feel a stretch along the front of the thigh. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your torso tall and the bent knee pointing at the floor beside your standing knee.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.

**Movement.** Lift one bent leg out to the side until your thigh is about level with your hips, then lower it back under you. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and your hips level, without leaning away from the lifting leg.

exercises.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips and your hands under your shoulders. Put one hand behind your head.

**Movement.** Turn your upper body down to bring that elbow toward the opposite wrist, then turn it up and open until the elbow points at the ceiling, following it with your eyes. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips square over your knees and your supporting arm straight.

exercises.name: Rack Pull (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the pins of a rack, or blocks, so the bar sits just below your knees. Stand close to it with your feet about hip-width apart, push your hips back and grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight, back flat.

**Movement.** Drive your hips forward and stand up with the bar against your thighs until your hips and knees are straight, then push your hips back to lower it to the pins.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Reach-Up Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat, and your arms straight up over your chest, fingers pointing at the ceiling.

**Movement.** Curl your head and shoulders off the floor and reach your hands up toward the ceiling as high as they go, then lower back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and pointing up, and your lower back on the floor.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a dumbbell in each hand. Push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent, arms hanging below your shoulders, palms facing each other.

**Movement.** Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your body, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** The same torso angle, your back flat and a small bend in your elbows that stays the same.

exercises.name: Recumbent Bike
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit back in the seat and slide it so your knee is slightly bent with the pedal at its farthest point. Hold the side handles.

**Movement.** Pedal in smooth circles for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the seat and your knees in line with your feet.

exercises.name: Renegade Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a push-up position with your hands on two dumbbells under your shoulders, arms straight, feet a little wider than hip-width.

**Movement.** Pull one dumbbell up to the side of your ribs, elbow going back, while the other arm holds you up, then set it back down and row with the other arm. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight from head to heels and your hips square to the floor, without twisting.

exercises.name: Backward Treadmill Walk
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the treadmill facing away from the console, hands lightly on the side rails, and start the belt at a low speed.

**Movement.** Walk backward, reaching back with the ball of each foot and rolling onto your heel, for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your steps short.

exercises.name: Reverse Clamshell
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on one side, legs stacked, with both hips and knees bent and your head resting on your lower arm.

**Movement.** Keep your knees together and lift your top foot up as far as it goes, turning the thigh in, then lower it back to the other foot. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your knees touching and your hips stacked, without rolling back.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your arms at your sides, palms down, and your hips and knees bent so your thighs point up.

**Movement.** Curl your hips up off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest, then lower your hips back down until your thighs point up again.

**Keep steady.** Your knees bent at the same angle, and your upper back and head on the floor.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand holding a bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms straight, the bar in front of your thighs.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to curl the bar up toward your shoulders with your palms still facing down, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach an EZ bar to a low cable. Stand facing it, take the bar with an overhand grip on the angled parts and step back so your arms hang straight with the cable taut.

**Movement.** Curl the bar up toward your shoulders with your palms still facing down, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench under a racked bar with your eyes under it and your feet flat. Grip the bar with your palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart, and lift it out over your chest, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your lower chest, elbows close to your sides, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your wrists straight, your shoulder blades pulled back and your hips on the bench.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell on each thigh. Lie back and press them over your chest, arms straight, palms facing your head.

**Movement.** Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your lower chest with your elbows close to your body, then press them back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows tucked in, your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a straight or EZ bar to a high cable. Stand facing it, take the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart and bring your elbows to your sides, forearms about level with the floor.

**Movement.** Push the bar down until your arms are straight, palms still facing up, then let it rise until your forearms are level again.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides, your wrists straight, and your upper arms and body still.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your front along a bench, hips at its end and legs hanging toward the floor, hands holding the sides of the bench.

**Movement.** Lift both legs together with your knees straight until they are in line with your body, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your chest and hips on the bench and your upper body still.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.

**Movement.** Step back with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to bring the back foot forward to standing. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your front shin close to upright.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic Curl
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel upright on a mat with your knees hip-width apart, the tops of your feet flat on the floor and your body straight from knees to head.

**Movement.** Lean back as one straight line, bending only at your knees, as far as you can, then pull yourself back up to upright.

**Keep steady.** Your hips straight, without bending at the waist.

exercises.name: Reverse Plank
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your hands flat on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.

**Movement.** Push through your hands and heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to heels, arms straight. Hold for the set time, then lower your hips.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line with your hips not sagging, and your head in line with your spine.

exercises.name: Reverse Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms on the pad and your armpits at its top edge. Hold an EZ bar with an overhand grip, hands close together, arms almost straight.

**Movement.** Curl the bar up toward your shoulders with your palms still facing down, then lower it until your arms are almost straight.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms on the pad, your wrists straight and your shoulders still.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down with your legs straight, your forehead just off the floor and your arms straight out in front of you, palms down.

**Movement.** Lift your arms off the floor and sweep them out to the sides and down until your hands reach your hips, then sweep them back up over your head the same way.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and off the floor the whole time, your legs down and your neck in line with your back.

exercises.name: Reverse V-Squat (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into the V-squat machine the reverse way, chest against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads, feet roughly shoulder-width apart on the platform. Release the safety.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower until your thighs are about level with the platform, then push back up.

**Keep steady.** Your chest against the pad, your whole foot down and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Reverse Wood Chop (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Anchor a band low, below knee height. Stand side-on to it with your feet wider than your shoulders and your knees bent, and hold the band with both hands outside your near hip.

**Movement.** Stand up as you pull the band up and across your body until your hands are above your far shoulder, turning your hips and chest to follow, then let it come back down the same path. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arms almost straight, the turn coming from your hips and torso.

exercises.name: Rice Bucket Training
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Pour dry rice into a deep bucket and stand or kneel beside it. Push one hand into the rice up to your wrist.

**Movement.** Inside the rice, make a fist and open it, rotate your wrist one way and then the other, and spread your fingers wide, moving from one to the next. Keep going for the set time, then switch hands.

**Keep steady.** Your hand under the rice and your forearm still.

exercises.name: Ring Dip
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a pair of gymnastic rings at about hip height. Grip one in each hand and jump or press up until your arms are straight and your body hangs between the rings.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows and lower yourself until your upper arms are about level with the rings, then press back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The rings close to your body and still, your shoulders down away from your ears and your legs still.

exercises.name: Ring Support Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a pair of gymnastic rings at about hip height. Hold one in each hand and jump or press up until your arms are straight and the rings are beside your hips.

**Movement.** Hold yourself up with your feet off the floor for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and close to your body, the rings turned slightly out, your shoulders down away from your ears and your legs together.

exercises.name: Rocking Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a rope to a high cable. Stand close to it in a split stance, hold an end in each hand and lean your upper body forward toward the rope, weight on your front foot.

**Movement.** Push the rope down as you rock your weight onto your back foot, until your arms are straight and your hands are behind your hips. Rock forward again as you let the rope rise.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows close to your sides and your chest up as you rock.

exercises.name: Roll Down
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, your knees slightly bent and your arms relaxed at your sides.

**Movement.** Drop your chin to your chest and curl forward from the top down, letting your arms hang, until your hands reach toward the floor. Then uncurl from the bottom up, stacking your back until you stand tall again.

**Keep steady.** Your weight over the middle of your feet and your knees slightly bent, without locking.

exercises.name: Roll-Over into V-Sit
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a mat with your legs straight out in front of you and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Roll back onto your upper back, swinging your legs up and over your head, then roll forward and open your legs wide as you come up, reaching your hands forward between them along the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight and your chin tucked as you roll back.

exercises.name: Roman Chair Sit-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a Roman chair facing away from the foot pads, hook your feet under them and rest the backs of your thighs on the seat pad, arms crossed on your chest.

**Movement.** Lean back until your torso is about level with the floor, then curl up and forward until your torso is nearly upright, and lean back again.

**Keep steady.** Your feet hooked in and your hips on the pad.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding the bar in front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs, feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs, knees slightly bent, until your hips go no further back without your back rounding. Then drive your hips forward to stand tall again.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your legs and the same small bend in your knees all the way.

exercises.name: Rope Climb
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand under a climbing rope and grip it overhead with both hands, one above the other, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up and pinch the rope between your feet, then stand up on your feet to reach higher with your hands. Repeat to the top or the set height, then climb back down hand under hand.

**Keep steady.** Your body close to the rope and your feet pinching it each time you reach higher.

exercises.name: Torso Rotation (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the machine with your legs held by the pads and set the start position turned to one side. Put your chest against the pad and take the handles.

**Movement.** Turn your torso against the weight toward the other side as far as the machine allows, then let it turn you back to the start. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and legs still, your shoulders turning with the pad.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the seat, strap your feet in across the widest part of each foot and take the handle with an overhand grip, arms straight, knees bent.

**Movement.** Push with your legs, then lean back a little and pull the handle to your lower ribs. Return in reverse: arms forward, lean forward from the hips, then bend your knees to slide back up. Keep going for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Your back straight, the handle moving in a level line, and your legs leading each stroke.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with a band looped around the sole of one foot and its ends held under your hands.

**Movement.** Push that foot back and up until your leg is straight and in line with your body, then bring the knee back under your hip. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat and your hips square to the floor.

exercises.name: Run
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall in running shoes on a path, track or road.

**Movement.** Run with short, quick steps, landing under your hips, for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Your torso tall and relaxed, your arms swinging forward and back rather than across your body.

exercises.name: Treadmill Run
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the treadmill's side rails, start the belt at a walk and step on.

**Movement.** Raise the speed to a run and keep running in the middle of the belt for the set distance or time, then lower the speed before stepping off.

**Keep steady.** Your torso tall, your steps under your hips, without holding the rails.

exercises.name: Runner's Lunge Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Step one foot forward into a long lunge and put both hands on the floor beside your front foot, back leg straight and back heel lifted.

**Movement.** Let your hips sink toward the floor until you feel a stretch at the front of your back hip. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your back knee straight and off the floor, and your front knee over your ankle.

exercises.name: Russian Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower your chest to just above the floor, then, staying low, slide your body forward so your shoulders move past your hands. Slide back and push up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your chest close to the floor while you slide, and your body in one straight line.

exercises.name: Russian Twist (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your knees bent, lean back until your torso is at about 45 degrees and lift your feet a little off the floor. Hold one dumbbell by its ends in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Turn your shoulders to one side and bring the dumbbell down beside your hip, then turn to bring it to the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your feet off the floor, your back long and your chest up, your shoulders turning more than your knees.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body rises a few inches without bending your elbows, then let your shoulders rise back up to a full hang.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight the whole time and your legs still.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders, arms straight and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Let your chest sink between your shoulders as your shoulder blades come together, then press your hands into the floor to spread them apart and round your upper back a little.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your body in one line and your hips neither sagging nor raised.

exercises.name: Scissor Kick
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides. Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.

**Movement.** Open your legs a little apart, then cross one over the other. Open them again and cross with the other leg on top. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight and off the floor, and your lower back down.

exercises.name: Scorpion Kick
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders, arms straight and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Lift one foot, bend that knee and turn your hips to reach the foot up and across behind you toward the opposite side, then bring it back to the floor. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hands planted, your arms straight and your shoulders over your hands.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the back pad so it sits across your upper back. Sit with your hips against the seat back and your feet on the platform, and cross your arms on your chest.

**Movement.** Push the pad back by straightening your back until your upper body is in line with your hips, then let it come forward again until you are bent over.

**Keep steady.** Your hips on the seat, your feet planted and your head in line with your back.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit with your legs out in front of you on the floor, knees slightly bent. Loop a band around the soles of your feet, hold an end in each hand with your arms straight, and sit tall.

**Movement.** Pull your hands to your lower ribs, elbows going back close to your sides, then let them go forward until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an upright bench in a rack with the bar just above your head when you sit. Sit with your back against the pad, grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and lift it off to the top of your chest.

**Movement.** Press the bar up past your face, tipping your head back a little, until your arms are straight overhead, then lower it to the top of your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad, your feet flat and your lower back still, without arching away from the pad.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Fly (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an upright bench between two cables with the pulleys at shoulder height when you sit. Sit with your back against the pad and take a handle in each hand, arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.

**Movement.** Sweep the handles in a wide arc until they meet ahead of your chest, then let them open back out along the same arc until your hands are about in line with your chest.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and the same small bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Seated Mid-Trap Shrug (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the low cable row with your feet on the platform and your knees slightly bent. Take the handle and sit tall with your arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull your shoulder blades back and together without bending your elbows, so the handle moves back a few inches, then let them spread forward again.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your torso upright and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the low cable row with your feet on the platform and your knees slightly bent. Take the handle with your arms straight and sit tall.

**Movement.** Pull the handle to your belly, elbows going back close to your sides, then let it go forward until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, without rocking back and forth.

exercises.name: Seated Corkscrew
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor and lean back on your hands placed behind your hips, knees bent and feet just off the floor.

**Movement.** Straighten your legs out in front of you, then pull your knees back in and across toward one shoulder, turning your hips. Straighten out again and pull in toward the other shoulder. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your feet off the floor and your chest up.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a step or plate, heels hanging off, and a dumbbell standing on end on each knee, held in place with your hands.

**Movement.** Raise your heels as high as you can, then lower them below the edge.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and the dumbbells on your knees.

exercises.name: Seated Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet flat, a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight at your sides and palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides, your upper arms still and your torso upright, without rocking.

exercises.name: Seated Figure-Four Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit tall on a bench with both feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the other knee.

**Movement.** Lean your chest forward from your hips over the crossed leg until you feel a stretch in its glute. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your back long and both sit bones on the bench.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and the pads against the insides of your knees, legs apart. Hold the handles.

**Movement.** Bring your knees together until the pads meet, then let them open back out as far as is comfortable.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your hips on the seat.

exercises.name: Seated Knee Extension Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor, one leg straight ahead with its heel up on a rolled towel or low block, so the back of the knee is off the floor.

**Movement.** Rest both hands over your lower thigh and lean your weight into them, letting the knee straighten down until the back of it pulls. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your leg relaxed and your heel on the towel.

exercises.name: Seated Knee Tuck
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor and lean back on your hands placed slightly behind your hips. Lift your feet just off the floor, knees bent.

**Movement.** Straighten your legs out in front of you as you lean back a little more, then pull your knees back in toward your chest as you sit up toward them.

**Keep steady.** Your feet off the floor the whole time and your chest up.

exercises.name: Seated Pancake Good Morning
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your legs straight and spread wide, toes pointing up, and your hands behind your head.

**Movement.** Tip your torso forward from your hips toward the floor between your legs as far as you can with a flat back, then sit back up tall.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight, your back flat and your elbows out.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so the handles are at chest height and sit with your chest against the pad. Take the handles, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull the handles back until your hands are beside your ribs, elbows going back, then let them return until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your chest against the pad and your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Extension Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your hands on the floor behind your hips, shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing back, arms straight.

**Movement.** Move your hips forward, away from your hands, letting your torso lower until you feel a stretch across the front of your shoulders and chest, then hold it for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows straight, your chest up and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Seated W Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at a steep incline and sit back against it, a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight and angled out a little from your sides, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up and out so they finish wide of your shoulders, your arms making a W, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the bench and your upper arms still.

exercises.name: Serratus Wall Slide
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a wall and put your forearms against it, shoulder-width apart, elbows at about chest height and hands pointing up.

**Movement.** Push your forearms into the wall to spread your shoulder blades, then slide them up the wall until your arms are almost overhead, and slide them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your forearms on the wall, your shoulder blades spread and your lower back still.

exercises.name: Shinbox Internal Rotation Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other bent out to the side behind you, both knees at about a right angle, hands on the floor.

**Movement.** Turn your chest toward your back leg and lean over it from your hips until you feel a stretch around the hip of that leg. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Both shins and knees on the floor and your back long.

exercises.name: Shotgun Row (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Take it in one hand, palm facing down, and step back into a wide split stance with the opposite foot in front, arm straight and shoulder reaching forward.

**Movement.** Pull the handle back to the side of your waist, turning your palm up as your elbow passes your body, then let it go forward until your arm is straight and your palm faces down. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and square to the cable.

exercises.name: Shoulder Pass-Through (Band)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding a band, stick or towel in both hands in front of your thighs, hands much wider than your shoulders, arms straight.

**Movement.** Raise your arms up over your head and on behind you until the band reaches your lower back, then bring them back over your head to the front.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight throughout, your ribs down and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Shoulder Pendulum (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand beside a bench and lean forward, resting one hand on it. Hold a dumbbell in your other hand and let that arm hang straight down.

**Movement.** Rock your body a little so the hanging arm swings and the dumbbell draws small circles under your shoulder, and keep it circling for the set time. Do the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arm relaxed and hanging, your back flat and your free hand on the bench.

exercises.name: Side-Lying External Rotation (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side on a mat with your head supported. Hold a dumbbell in your top hand with that elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your side, forearm across your belly.

**Movement.** Turn your forearm up until the dumbbell points toward the ceiling, then lower it back across your belly. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow against your side and bent to the same angle, and your body still.

exercises.name: Wall Shoulder Flexion Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a wall about a step away. Put both hands flat on it above your head, a little wider than your shoulders, arms straight.

**Movement.** Walk your feet back and hinge at your hips so your chest drops toward the floor between your arms, until you feel a stretch along your sides and under your arms. Hold it for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your back flat and your lower back not arching.

exercises.name: Internal Rotation (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a cable at elbow height. Stand side-on to it and take the handle in your near hand, elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your side, forearm pointing out toward the machine.

**Movement.** Turn your forearm in across your belly as far as your shoulder allows, then let it go back out toward the machine. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow against your side and bent to the same angle, and your torso still.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the bar in a rack at upper-chest height. Grip it just wider than your shoulders, step under so it rests on the front of your shoulders, and step back with your feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Press the bar straight up, moving your head back a little to let it pass, until your arms are straight overhead with the bar over the middle of your feet. Lower it back to your shoulders.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight and your body upright, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a bench with its back set upright, a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows under your hands.

**Movement.** Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight overhead, then lower them back to shoulder height.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your feet flat.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height. Sit with your back against the pad and take the handles.

**Movement.** Press the handles up until your arms are straight, then lower them back to shoulder height.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad and your feet flat.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set an upright bench under a Smith machine bar so the bar comes down just in front of your face. Sit with your back against the pad, grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and unhook it.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to about chin height, just above your upper chest, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the pad, your feet flat and your head still.

exercises.name: Three-Point Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor under your shoulders and step your feet back, about hip-width apart, so your body is straight from head to heels. Lift one foot a little off the floor.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level, your body in one straight line and your raised foot off the floor.

exercises.name: Y-Raise (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set both pulleys at the bottom. Stand between them and cross your arms, taking the left cable in your right hand and the right cable in your left, hands in front of your hips.

**Movement.** Pull your hands up and out past your head into a Y shape, elbows leading and close to your body at first, until your arms are almost straight overhead, then lower them back to your hips.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright without leaning back, and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Shrimp Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg and bend the other knee to bring that foot up behind you, holding it with the hand on the same side. Reach your free arm forward.

**Movement.** Bend your standing knee and lower until the knee of your held leg touches the floor behind you, then stand back up on the same leg. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your standing heel down, your chest up and your standing knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Shrug (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding the bar in front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as they go, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and the bar close to your thighs, without rolling your shoulders.

exercises.name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.

**Movement.** Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as they go, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and your head still, without rolling your shoulders.

exercises.name: Shrug (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a Smith machine bar at about mid-thigh height. Stand close to it, grip it with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart and unhook it, arms straight, the bar against your thighs.

**Movement.** Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as they go, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and your head still, without rolling your shoulders.

exercises.name: Side Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side on a mat with your legs straight and stacked, knees slightly bent. Rest your lower arm on the floor in front of you and put your top hand lightly behind your head.

**Movement.** Lift your upper body sideways, bringing your top elbow toward your hip, then lower back down. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips stacked and your body facing forward, without rolling onto your back.

exercises.name: Side Kick Drill
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Start at the wall and glide out lying on one side, the lower arm reaching ahead, a kickboard under that hand if you use one.

**Movement.** Kick steadily for the set distance, turning your head to the side to breathe and back down again.

**Keep steady.** Your body on its side in a straight line, one ear in the water.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Internal Rotation (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side on a flat bench, your lower elbow on the bench just in front of your ribs and bent to 90 degrees, holding a dumbbell so your forearm hangs down past the edge.

**Movement.** Turn your forearm up and in until the dumbbell reaches your belly, then lower it back down past the edge of the bench as far as your shoulder allows. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow in place and bent to the same angle, and your body still.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side with your head on your lower arm, your bottom leg bent for balance and your top leg straight in line with your body.

**Movement.** Lift your top leg toward the ceiling as far as it goes without rolling, then lower it back down. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips stacked, your toes pointing forward and your top knee straight.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder, legs straight and feet stacked.

**Movement.** Lift your hips off the floor until your body is straight from head to feet, resting on your forearm and the side of your lower foot. Hold for the set time, then lower and switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your hips lifted in line with your body and your chest facing forward, without rolling.

exercises.name: Side Shuffle to Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders in a low athletic stance, knees and hips bent and hands up in front.

**Movement.** Shuffle sideways three steps, pushing off your trailing foot, then turn half a circle on your lead foot and drop into a squat. Stand and shuffle back the other way, and keep going.

**Keep steady.** Low through the shuffle, your feet never crossing and your chest up.

exercises.name: Side Split Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet wide apart, a little more than shoulder-width, toes pointing forward and hands in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Bend one knee and sit your hips back over that foot until the thigh is about level with the floor, your other leg straight, then push back up to the middle. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Both feet flat and in place, your chest up and your bent knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Side Straight-Arm Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a high cable. Stand side-on to it and take the handle in your near hand, arm straight and reaching up and out to the side.

**Movement.** Pull the handle down in a wide arc along your side until your hand is beside your thigh, arm straight, then let it rise back along the same arc. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and still, without leaning or twisting, and your arm straight.

exercises.name: Standing Side Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, one arm straight overhead and the other hand on your hip.

**Movement.** Lean your upper body to the side away from the raised arm, reaching it up and over, until you feel the stretch along that side of your body. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and still, and your chest facing forward without twisting.

exercises.name: Side-to-Side Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor wider than a normal push-up and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Shift your weight toward one hand and bend your elbows to lower your chest over that hand, then push back up and return to the middle. Do the next rep over the other hand. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and your hips level.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Bicep Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a single handle to a low cable. Stand facing it, take the handle in one hand with your palm facing up and step back until your arm hangs straight with the cable taut.

**Movement.** Curl the handle up toward your shoulder, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow at your side and your upper arm still, without leaning back or turning your body.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
aliases: One Arm Triceps Extensions on Cable
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a single handle to a high cable. Stand facing it, take the handle in one hand and bring that elbow to your side, forearm about level with the floor.

**Movement.** Push the handle down until your arm is straight, then let it rise until your forearm is level again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your elbow at your side, and your upper arm and body still.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Rotating Row (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Kneel on one knee facing it, other foot in front. Take the handle in the hand on the side of your down knee and turn your chest toward the cable, other hand on your front knee.

**Movement.** Pull the handle to your waist while turning your chest away from the cable, then let it go forward as you turn back. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips square and still.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height, palm facing in or forward, elbow under your hand.

**Movement.** Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight overhead, then lower it back to shoulder height. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and square, without leaning away from the dumbbell, and your free hand at your side.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Clean (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet hip-width apart, a kettlebell on the floor between them. Push your hips back and grip the handle with one hand.

**Movement.** Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward and pull it up close to your body, turning your hand so the bell rolls onto your forearm at your shoulder. Drop it back between your legs. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your elbow close to your side and the bell close to your body.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Row (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Step one foot forward, bend both knees and lean forward until your back is flat at about 45 degrees, one hand on your front thigh. Hold a kettlebell in the other hand, arm straight below your shoulder.

**Movement.** Pull the kettlebell up to the side of your waist, elbow going back past your body, then lower it until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your free hand on your thigh and your shoulders square to the floor, without twisting.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Shoulder Press (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, a kettlebell held in one hand at your shoulder, the bell resting on the back of your forearm and your elbow in front of your ribs.

**Movement.** Press the kettlebell up until your arm is straight overhead, upper arm beside your ear, then lower it back to your shoulder. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and square, without leaning away from the bell, your legs straight and your wrist straight.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Snatch (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet hip-width apart, a kettlebell on the floor between them. Push your hips back and grip the handle with one hand.

**Movement.** Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward and pull it up close to your body, punching your hand through near the top so your arm finishes straight overhead. Bring it back down between your legs. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bell close to your body on the way up and your wrist straight overhead.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Swing (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet a little wider than hip-width and a kettlebell on the floor a step in front of you. Push your hips back and grip the handle with one hand.

**Movement.** Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward to stand tall and let it swing up to about chest height on a straight arm. Let it fall back as you push your hips back again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your shoulders square and your working arm straight.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Fit a single handle to the pulldown and sit with your thighs under the pads. Take the handle in one hand, palm facing in, arm straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, elbow going down toward your hip, then let it rise until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and square, without leaning toward the working side.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand straight overhead, palm facing in.

**Movement.** Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head, then straighten your arm to lift it back overhead. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm beside your head and still, your elbow pointing forward and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Plank Row (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put a kettlebell on the floor and get into a push-up position, one hand flat on the floor and the other gripping the kettlebell's handle under your shoulder, feet wider than hip-width.

**Movement.** Pull the kettlebell up to the side of your ribs, elbow going back, then set it down again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight from head to heels and your hips square to the floor, without twisting.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at a preacher bench with the back of one upper arm on the pad and your armpit at its top edge. Hold a dumbbell in that hand, palm up, arm almost straight.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, then lower it until your arm is almost straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arm on the pad and your shoulder still.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance with Eyes Closed
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand near a wall and balance on one leg, its knee a little bent, the other foot just off the floor and your arms relaxed at your sides.

**Movement.** Close your eyes and keep your balance on the standing leg. Hold the position for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and your standing foot flat, without hopping.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Around-the-Body Pass (Kettlebell)
aliases: Kettlebell Body Circle on One Leg
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg with that knee slightly bent and the other foot just off the floor, holding a kettlebell by its handle in front of you.

**Movement.** Pass the kettlebell around your waist, switching hands in front and behind you to make full circles, then circle the other way. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level, your torso upright and your free foot off the floor.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Half-Ball Balance
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put a half-ball balance trainer dome side up on the floor and step onto its centre with one foot, the other foot lifted just clear.

**Movement.** Keep your balance on the dome with your standing knee slightly bent. Hold the position for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level, your torso upright and your standing knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg with that knee slightly bent, holding a dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg, arm straight.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and tip your torso forward as your free leg rises behind you, lowering the dumbbell toward the floor until your body and back leg are close to level, then return to standing. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and square to the floor, your back flat and the dumbbell under your shoulder.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Extension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the leg extension machine with your back against the pad and your knees lined up with its pivot. Hook one ankle under the lower pad and hold the handles.

**Movement.** Straighten that knee to lift the pad until your leg is straight, then lower it until the knee is bent again. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back and hips against the seat and your other leg relaxed.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor and arms at your sides. Lift one foot and straighten that leg, thighs side by side.

**Movement.** Push through the heel of your planted foot to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee, then lower them back to the floor. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level, your raised leg in line with your other thigh and your upper back on the floor.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Ball Leg Curl
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your heels on a Swiss ball and your arms on the floor at your sides. Lift your hips until your body is straight, then lift one foot off the ball.

**Movement.** Bend the knee of the leg on the ball to roll it in toward your glutes, then straighten it to roll the ball back out. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips up and level, your shoulders on the floor and your free leg still.

exercises.name: Seated Single-Leg Hamstring Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit down with one leg straight ahead, toes up. Fold the other leg in so its sole rests on the inside of the straight thigh.

**Movement.** Fold forward from your hips over the straight leg, reaching toward your foot, until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your straight knee pointing up and your back long.

exercises.name: Lunge (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a kettlebell by the sides of its handle against your chest and stand with your feet together.

**Movement.** Take a long step forward with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot to step back to standing. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, the kettlebell against your chest and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit in the leg press with your back and hips against the pad. Put one foot in the middle of the platform, rest the other on the floor or the frame, then press it up and release the safety handles.

**Movement.** Bend your knee to lower the platform until your knee comes close to your chest, then press it back up until your leg is almost straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and lower back on the pad and your knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg with that knee slightly bent and your arms hanging in front of you.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and tip your torso forward as your free leg rises behind you, reaching your hands toward the floor until your body and back leg are close to level, then return to standing. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and square to the floor, your back flat and the same small bend in your standing knee.

exercises.name: Side Glute Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your side on the leg press seat with your hips stacked, and put your top foot high on the platform, toes turned out a little. Press it up and release the safety handles.

**Movement.** Bend your knee to lower the platform toward your chest, then push through your heel to press it back up until your leg is almost straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips stacked on the pad and your knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Soft-Landing Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted just off the floor and your arms relaxed.

**Movement.** Hop a short way forward on your standing leg and land on the same foot, sinking into a quarter squat, and stay still there for a moment before standing tall. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your landing knee in line with your toes, your hips level and your chest up.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet hip-width apart, one hand holding a post or rack beside you, and rise onto the balls of your feet.

**Movement.** Bend your knees forward and lower them toward the floor as you lean back, your body straight from knees to head, until your knees are deeply bent. Straighten your knees to come back up.

**Keep steady.** Your hips straight, without bending at the waist, and your heels off the floor.

exercises.name: Sit and Reach
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on a mat with your legs straight out in front of you and together, toes pointing up.

**Movement.** Fold forward from your hips and reach your hands along your legs toward or past your toes until you feel the stretch along the backs of your legs. Hold it for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight and your back long rather than hunched.

exercises.name: Sit-Up Elbow Thrust
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, fists by your chest and elbows bent.

**Movement.** Sit up, and at the top turn and drive one elbow across your body past the opposite knee, then turn back to the middle and lower down. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your feet flat on the floor and your hips still as your shoulders turn.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hooked under something solid if you need it, hands crossed on your chest.

**Movement.** Curl your head and shoulders up and keep rolling until your chest is close to your thighs, then roll back down until your shoulders touch the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your feet on the floor and your hands on your chest, without throwing your arms forward.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad on your thighs just above your knees. Release the safety lever.

**Movement.** Raise your heels as high as you can, then lower them below the platform.

**Keep steady.** Your torso still and your knees under the pad.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with one leg straight in front of you and loop a towel or strap around the ball of that foot, holding an end in each hand.

**Movement.** Pull the towel toward you to draw your toes back toward your shin until you feel a stretch in your calf. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your knee straight and your back tall.

exercises.name: Ski Machine
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing the machine with your feet hip-width apart and reach up to take a handle in each hand, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull the handles down in front of you, bending your hips and knees as your hands pass your face, until your hands reach past your thighs. Stand back up as you let the handles rise overhead, and keep going for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms nearly straight and close together, and your back flat as you bend.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, arms straight, palms facing each other.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head, then straighten your arms to press them back up.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms still and pointing up, and your elbows in.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar over your chest, arms straight, hands about shoulder-width apart on the angled parts.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, then straighten your arms to press it back up.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms still and pointing up, and your elbows in.

exercises.name: Skydiver
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down with your legs straight and a little wider than your shoulders, and your arms straight out to the sides in a T, palms down.

**Movement.** Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together, turning your thumbs up and drawing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your neck in line with your back and your eyes on the floor.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Load a sled and stand behind it with your hands on the high posts, arms nearly straight, leaning forward so your body is at about 45 degrees.

**Movement.** Drive the sled forward with short steps, pushing off the balls of your feet, for the set distance.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms nearly straight and your body at the same forward lean.

exercises.name: Sleeper Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on one side on a mat with your head supported. Reach your lower arm out in front of you at shoulder height, then bend the elbow to 90 degrees so your fingers point at the ceiling.

**Movement.** With your top hand, press your lower forearm down toward the floor until you feel a stretch at the back of the shoulder. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your lower elbow on the floor in line with your shoulder, and your body on its side without rolling back.

exercises.name: Sliding Lateral Lunge (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a kettlebell by the sides of its handle against your chest. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and one foot on a slider or towel.

**Movement.** Slide that foot out to the side as you bend the other knee and sit your hips back over it, then pull the sliding foot back in to stand. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your sliding leg straight and your bent knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Sloper Hang
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Reach up to a fingerboard and lay your open hands over its sloping holds, hands about shoulder-width apart, fingers together.

**Movement.** Lift your feet so you hang with your arms straight. Hold the hang for the set time, then step back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your shoulders pulled down and your hands open on the slope.

exercises.name: Negative Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a box under a pull-up bar, climb onto it and take the bar a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away. Rise until your chin is over the bar and your elbows are fully bent.

**Movement.** Lift your feet clear and let yourself down, taking as long as you can, until you hang on straight arms. Climb back onto the box and rise to the top again for the next rep.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still and your shoulders down away from your ears on the way down.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a flat bench under a Smith machine so the bar comes down over the middle of your chest. Lie on it with your feet flat, grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and unhook it, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar until it touches your chest just below the nipples, then press it up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulder blades pulled back into the bench, your hips down and your feet flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the Smith machine bar at about shoulder height and step under so it rests across your upper back. Put the balls of your feet on a plate or step under the bar, heels hanging off, and unhook it.

**Movement.** Rise onto your toes as high as you can, then lower your heels below the edge.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight, your body upright and your hands either side of your shoulders.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a flat bench under a Smith machine bar so the bar is over your lower chest. Lie back, take the bar with your hands at shoulder width and turn it to unhook it, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows close to your sides, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows tucked in, your shoulder blades pulled back and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the Smith machine bar at about shoulder height and step under so it rests across your upper back. Unhook it and set your feet in a long split stance, one well ahead of the other, back heel lifted.

**Movement.** Bend both knees and lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push back up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your feet in place and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Squat (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the Smith machine bar at about shoulder height and step under so it rests across your upper back, hands just outside your shoulders. Stand up to unhook it, feet about shoulder-width apart and a little ahead of the bar.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your whole foot down and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Glute Ball Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with a lacrosse or massage ball under one glute, your hands on the floor behind you and that ankle crossed over the other knee.

**Movement.** Shift your weight to roll the ball around the glute in small circles and lines. Roll for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your hands and planted foot taking as much of your weight as you need.

exercises.name: Snap Down
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall up on your toes with your feet together and your arms reaching overhead.

**Movement.** Drive your arms down and back as you drop your hips and land flat-footed in a quarter squat, chest forward, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your feet landing about hip-width apart and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Snatch (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, the bar over the middle of your feet. Bend at your hips and knees and take a wide grip, hands far outside your shoulders, arms straight, back flat.

**Movement.** Pull the bar off the floor, then drive your hips and knees straight to send it up close to your body. Pull yourself under it into a squat, catching it overhead on straight arms, then stand up with the bar overhead and lower it.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the bar close to your body and your arms straight in the catch.

exercises.name: Snatch Pull (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart. Bend at your hips and knees and take a wide grip, hands far outside your shoulders, arms straight and back flat.

**Movement.** Lift the bar past your knees, then straighten your hips and knees fast as it reaches your upper thighs, rising onto your toes and shrugging your shoulders up. Lower the bar back to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, the bar close to your body and your back flat.

exercises.name: Sphinx Pose
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down with your legs straight and the tops of your feet on the floor.

**Movement.** Bring your forearms under you with your elbows under your shoulders and press down through them to raise your chest, letting your lower back curve. Hold for the set time, then lower back down.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and legs resting on the floor, and your shoulders down and wide.

exercises.name: Spider Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench at about 45 degrees and lie face down on it with your chest on the pad and your feet on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, then lower them until your arms hang straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the pad and your upper arms hanging straight down and still.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Sit-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face up, legs long, with your elbows bent to right angles beside you and your hands pointing up.

**Movement.** Sit up and twist to one side as you pull the opposite knee in to meet your elbow, swinging the other arm back. Lower back down as your leg straightens, then do the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your other leg straight on the floor.

exercises.name: Split Jerk (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with the bar racked on the front of your shoulders, hands just wider than your shoulders, elbows slightly in front of the bar and feet about hip-width apart.

**Movement.** Dip a short way at your knees and drive up through your legs. As the bar leaves your shoulders, push yourself under it, splitting one foot forward and one back to catch it on straight arms. Step your feet level, then lower the bar to your shoulders.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright in the dip, and the bar over the middle of your body in the catch.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in a long split stance, one foot well ahead of the other, back heel lifted and hands on your hips.

**Movement.** Bend both knees and lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push back up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your feet in place, your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Squat down until your thighs are about level with the floor, then jump straight up as high as you can, swinging your arms up. Land on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next squat.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up and your knees in line with your toes on every landing.

exercises.name: Squat Sky Reach Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit down into a deep squat with your feet a little wider than your hips. Hold the inside of one ankle with the opposite hand and bring your other hand to your chest.

**Movement.** Turn your chest and reach that arm up toward the ceiling until it points straight up, then bring it back down to your chest. Keep turning up and back for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your heels down, your hand on your ankle and your hips low in the squat.

exercises.name: Squat Thrust
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Squat down and put your hands on the floor in front of your feet, jump your feet back into a plank, jump them back in toward your hands, then stand up.

**Keep steady.** Your body straight in the plank, hips neither sagging nor raised.

exercises.name: Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the bar in a rack at shoulder height. Step under it, rest it across your upper back, grip it either side of your shoulders and stand up to lift it off. Step back and set your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees together and sit down between your heels until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your back flat, your whole foot on the floor and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Step onto the stairs, hold the side rails lightly and pick a speed or program on the console.

**Movement.** Climb the moving steps one at a time, putting your whole foot on each step and pushing through it to stand tall before the next. Keep going for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Upright, without leaning your weight on the rails, and your feet in the middle of the steps.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Adduction (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Strap an ankle cuff to one ankle and attach it to a low cable. Stand side-on with the cuffed leg nearer the machine, hold the frame and step away until the cable pulls that leg out to the side.

**Movement.** Pull the cuffed leg in and across in front of your standing leg, then let it go back out to the side. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips square and your torso upright, without leaning.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the step with the balls of your feet on its edge and your shoulders under the pads, heels hanging below.

**Movement.** Rise onto your toes as high as you can, then lower your heels below the step.

**Keep steady.** Your legs straight and your body upright.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a wall with your hands on it at shoulder height. Step one foot back with that leg straight and the heel down, front knee bent.

**Movement.** Lean your hips toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf of your back leg. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your back heel on the floor, your back knee straight and your back foot pointing forward.

exercises.name: Standing IT Band Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall and cross one foot behind the other, both feet flat. Raise the arm on the side of the back leg overhead.

**Movement.** Push the hip of your back leg out to the side and lean your torso the other way, reaching your arm over, until you feel a stretch along the outside of that hip and thigh. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Both feet flat and your back knee straight.

exercises.name: Standing Pancake
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet as wide as you can comfortably go, toes pointing forward.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and fold forward from them with a flat back, your hands reaching toward the floor, until you feel a stretch along your inner thighs and hamstrings. Hold the stretch for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight and your weight over the middle of your feet.

exercises.name: Standing Pancake Good Morning
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet wide, well past shoulder-width, toes turned out a little and your hands behind your head.

**Movement.** Push your hips back and tip your torso forward until it is close to level with the floor, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your elbows out and your knees nearly straight.

exercises.name: Standing Side Crunch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall, feet a shoulder-width apart, fingertips resting behind your head and elbows pointing out to the sides.

**Movement.** Lift one knee out to the side and up as you bend that side of your body down, bringing your elbow and knee toward each other, then return to standing. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your standing leg straight and your chest facing forward, bending sideways without twisting.

exercises.name: Standing Soleus Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a wall with your hands on it and step one foot back a short way, both heels down.

**Movement.** Bend both knees, sinking your back knee toward the floor, until you feel a stretch low in the calf of your back leg, near the ankle. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your back heel on the floor and your back foot pointing forward.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent with the pedal at the bottom, and the handlebars within easy reach. Sit, put your feet on the pedals and set the resistance.

**Movement.** Pedal in smooth circles, pushing down and pulling round through the bottom, and change the resistance or pace as the session calls for. Keep going for the set distance or time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips still on the seat, without rocking side to side, and your knees in line with your feet.

exercises.name: Step Calf Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand on the edge of a step on the balls of both feet, heels off the back, one hand on a rail or wall.

**Movement.** Let your heels sink below the step until your calves pull. Hold the stretch for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight and your body upright.

exercises.name: Step Jack
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Step one foot out to the side as you raise both arms out and up overhead, then bring the foot and arms back in. Step the other foot out next, and keep going side to side for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your arms straight, with one foot always on the floor.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a sturdy box or bench about knee height and put one foot flat on top of it.

**Movement.** Push through that foot to step up until your leg is straight, bringing the other foot up beside it, then step back down with the other foot first. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your whole working foot on the box and your knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and the bar over the middle of your feet. Hinge down with your knees only slightly bent and grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight.

**Movement.** Drive your hips forward to stand tall with the bar against your legs, then push your hips back to lower it to the floor, legs nearly straight the whole time.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, the small bend in your knees and the bar close to your legs.

exercises.name: Stomach Vacuum
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your hands on your hips, or get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.

**Movement.** Pull your belly in and up under your ribs as far as it goes, so your stomach hollows out. Hold it there for the set time, then let it go.

**Keep steady.** Your back and hips still, so only your belly moves.

exercises.name: Straddle L-Sit
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your legs straight and spread wide, and put your hands flat on the floor between your thighs, fingers pointing forward.

**Movement.** Press down through straight arms to lift your hips and legs off the floor, legs held straight and wide at about hip height. Hold for the set time, then sit back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms and legs straight and your shoulders pushed down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pullback (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in. Push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent, arms hanging below your shoulders with a small bend in the elbows.

**Movement.** Sweep the dumbbells back in an arc past your hips until your arms are in line with your body, then bring them back down below your shoulders along the same arc.

**Keep steady.** The same small bend in your elbows, your back flat and your torso still.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Rope Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a rope to a high cable. Stand facing it a step back, lean forward a little, and hold an end in each hand, arms straight and reaching forward at about head height.
