**Movement.** Pull the rope down in an arc to your hips with your arms straight, spreading the ends apart at the bottom, then let it rise back along the same arc.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your torso at the same lean and your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a straight bar to a high cable. Stand facing it a step back, lean forward a little, and take the bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms straight out in front at about head height.

**Movement.** Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs with your arms straight, then let it rise back along the same arc to head height.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your torso at the same lean and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Straight-Leg Hamstring Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie flat on your back, legs straight on the floor.

**Movement.** Raise one leg with the knee straight and hold the back of that thigh or calf with both hands, drawing it toward you until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your other leg flat on the floor, your raised knee straight and your hips down.

exercises.name: Stroke and Roll Drill
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Push off the wall face down.

**Movement.** Swim a few freestyle strokes, roll onto your back for a few breaths, then roll back and carry on, for the set distance.

**Keep steady.** Your body turning as one piece, head in line with your spine.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand at your side, arm straight, your other arm free.

**Movement.** Walk forward with even steps for the set distance, the dumbbell hanging at your side. Then switch hands and walk with it on the other side.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders level and your body upright, without leaning away from the dumbbell or toward it.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, the bar over the middle of your feet. Bend your knees out over your toes and grip the bar between your legs, hands about shoulder-width apart, arms straight, chest up.

**Movement.** Push your knees out and the floor away to stand up until your hips and knees are straight, then lower the bar to the floor the same way.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your knees in line with your toes and the bar close to your body.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet well wider than your shoulders, toes turned out, and your hands together in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Bend your knees out over your toes and sit straight down until your thighs are about level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your knees out in line with your toes and your heels down.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down on a mat with your legs straight and your arms straight out in front of you.

**Movement.** Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together until your body forms a shallow curve, then lower them back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms and legs straight, and your neck in line with your back, eyes on the floor.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Abduction
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on a mat with your legs straight and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Lift one leg just off the floor and move it out to the side as far as it goes, then bring it back beside the other. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your toes pointing up, your hips level and your other leg still.

exercises.name: Supported Deep Squat Hold
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a rack, door frame or sturdy post, feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned out, holding it with both hands.

**Movement.** Sit down into the deepest squat you can with your heels on the floor, holding on for balance. Hold the position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your heels down, your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Supported Split Squat
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand in a long split stance next to a rack, wall or chair, one foot well ahead of the other and back heel lifted, one hand resting on the support.

**Movement.** Bend both knees and lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push back up. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your feet in place and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the straps to about chest height. Face away from the anchor, hold a handle in each hand, arms straight in front of your chest and palms facing, and lean forward onto them.

**Movement.** Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc, letting your chest move down toward the handles, until your hands are about level with your chest. Bring them back together in front to lift yourself back up.

**Keep steady.** The same small bend in your elbows, and your body straight from head to heels.

exercises.name: Knee Tuck (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Shorten the straps until the foot cradles hang a little above the floor. Lie face down with your feet in the cradles and press up into a high plank, hands under your shoulders.

**Movement.** Pull both knees straight in toward your chest, then push your legs back out until your body is straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your hands under your shoulders, your arms straight and your hips square, without swinging the straps sideways.

exercises.name: Push-Up (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the handles at about mid-shin height and face away from the anchor. Hold one in each hand under your shoulders, arms straight, and walk your feet back until your body forms one straight line from head to heels.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest between the handles, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and the handles close together under your chest.

exercises.name: Swiss Ball Knee Tuck
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel in front of a Swiss ball, put your hands on the floor under your shoulders and walk them out until your shins rest on the ball and your body is straight in a high plank.

**Movement.** Pull your knees in toward your chest, rolling the ball forward under your shins, then push your legs back out to the plank.

**Keep steady.** Your hands under your shoulders, your arms straight and your hips level.

exercises.name: Swiss Ball Leg Curl
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your arms out on the floor and both heels on top of a Swiss ball, legs straight. Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to heels.

**Movement.** Bend your knees to roll the ball in toward your glutes, then straighten your legs to roll it back out.

**Keep steady.** Your hips up the whole time and your shoulders and arms on the floor.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row (Landmine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a barbell in a landmine, load its free end and stand astride the bar facing the plates. Fit a V-handle under the bar by the plates, push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is at about 45 degrees, knees slightly bent, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull the handle up toward your chest, elbows going back close to your sides, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The same torso angle, your back flat and your hips still.

exercises.name: Butt Kick
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent at your sides.

**Movement.** Jog in place, bringing each heel up behind you toward your glutes as it leaves the floor, switching legs fast and swinging your arms with them. Keep going for the set time, in place or moving forward.

**Keep steady.** Your knees pointing down at the floor and your torso upright.

exercises.name: Thruster (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold a barbell resting on the front of your shoulders, hands just outside them and elbows forward, feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Front squat down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand up hard and use that drive to press the bar overhead until your arms are straight. Lower it to your shoulders as you go into the next squat.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows up in the squat, your chest up and the bar over the middle of your feet at the top.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your back against a wall and your heels about a foot's length out from it, legs straight.

**Movement.** Lift the fronts of your feet as high as they go, rocking back onto your heels, then lower them back to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your back and hips against the wall and your knees straight.

exercises.name: Toe Tap
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with your arms at your sides and your hips and knees bent to right angles, shins level with the floor.

**Movement.** Lower one foot to tap the floor, keeping the knee bent at the same angle, then bring it back up to the start. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your lower back on the floor and your other leg still.

exercises.name: Standing Toe Touch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet together or a little apart and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Fold forward from your hips and reach your hands down toward your toes as far as you comfortably can, then roll back up to standing.

**Keep steady.** Your knees straight but not locked and your weight over the middle of your feet.

exercises.name: Toes-to-Bar
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms straight and legs together.

**Movement.** Lift your legs in front of you, keeping them nearly straight, and curl your hips up until your toes touch the bar between your hands. Lower your legs until they hang straight below you.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Torso Rotation Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms crossed over your chest.

**Movement.** Turn your upper body to one side as far as it goes while your hips keep facing forward. Hold it for the set time on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and feet facing forward and your body upright, without leaning.

exercises.name: Standing Torso Twist
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Raise your arms in front of your chest, elbows bent and hands together.

**Movement.** Turn your shoulders and chest to one side as far as they go, then turn through the middle to the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hips and feet facing forward and still, with only your upper body turning.

exercises.name: Towel Hang
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Loop a pair of towels across a pull-up bar about shoulder-width apart. Take the hanging ends of one towel in each hand.

**Movement.** Lift your feet so you hang with your arms straight. Hold the hang for the set time, then step back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your shoulders pulled down and your legs still.

exercises.name: Towel Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Drape a towel over a pull-up bar above each shoulder. Grip one in each hand, palms facing in, and lift your feet so you hang on straight arms.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to raise your body until the bar is level with your chin, then let yourself down until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still, your body not swinging and your grip on the towels, not the bar.

exercises.name: Towel Superman
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down with your legs straight. Hold a towel with your hands wider than your shoulders and stretch your arms out in front of you, pulling the towel taut.

**Movement.** Lift your chest and arms off the floor, then bend your elbows to bring the towel down behind your head toward your upper back. Reach your arms forward again and lower your chest.

**Keep steady.** The towel taut, your legs on the floor and your neck in line with your back.

exercises.name: Trap-3 Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hinge forward until your torso is close to level with the floor, knees slightly bent. Rest one hand on your knee or a bench and let a light dumbbell hang from the other hand, thumb pointing forward.

**Movement.** Raise your arm forward and out at an angle, in line with your ear like one arm of a Y, until it is level with your body, then lower it. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight, your torso still and your shoulder down away from your ear.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Trap Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand inside the trap bar with your feet about hip-width apart. Bend at your hips and knees and take the handles, arms straight, back flat, chest up.

**Movement.** Push the floor away and stand up until your hips and knees are straight, then bend your hips and knees to lower the bar to the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your back flat, your arms straight and the bar level.

exercises.name: Lying Scapular Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight up over your chest, palms facing each other.

**Movement.** Without bending your elbows, push the dumbbells up toward the ceiling so your shoulder blades lift off the bench, then let them sink back until your shoulders rest on the bench again.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows straight throughout and your head and hips on the bench.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, knees slightly bent, and hinge forward at your hips until your torso is close to level with the floor. Bring your upper arms back alongside your body, elbows bent, palms facing in.

**Movement.** Straighten your arms to push the dumbbells back until your arms are straight, then bend your elbows to let them return.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms level with the floor and still, and your back flat.

exercises.name: Triceps Rope Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a rope to a high cable. Stand facing it and hold an end in each hand, palms facing in, elbows at your sides and forearms about level with the floor.

**Movement.** Press the rope down until your arms are straight, pulling the ends out to your sides at the bottom, then let it rise until your forearms are level again.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides, and your upper arms and body still.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the assistance weight, kneel on the pad or step onto the platform, and grip the dip handles. Let the pad take some of your weight as you press up until your arms are straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows and lower yourself until your upper arms are about level with the handles, then press back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders down away from your ears and your knees or feet on the pad.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad with your elbows lined up with the machine's pivot. Take the handles with your elbows bent.

**Movement.** Straighten your arms to push the handles away until your arms are straight, then let them return until your elbows are bent again.

**Keep steady.** Your upper arms on the pad, your back against the seat and your shoulders still.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
aliases: Triceps Extensions on Cable With Bar
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a straight or angled bar to a high cable. Stand facing it, take the bar with an overhand grip and bring your elbows to your sides, forearms about level with the floor.

**Movement.** Push the bar down until your arms are straight, then let it rise until your forearms are level again.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides, and your upper arms and body still.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown Hold (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Attach a straight bar or rope to a high cable. Stand facing it, take it in both hands and lean forward a little at the hips, elbows at your sides.

**Movement.** Push down until your arms are straight. Hold the bar there for the set time, then let it rise.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides, and your upper arms and body still.

exercises.name: Triceps Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand or sit tall. Raise one arm, bend the elbow and let your hand drop behind your head toward your upper back.

**Movement.** Take that elbow with your other hand and draw it back and toward your head until you feel it along the back of your arm. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your head still, without leaning to the side.

exercises.name: Trunk Rotation (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a handle on a cable at chest height. Stand side-on to it, feet shoulder-width apart, and hold the handle in both hands at arm's length in front of your chest.

**Movement.** Turn your shoulders away from the machine until the handle is in front of your far shoulder, then let it turn you back toward the machine. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight in front of your chest and your hips facing forward, with only your torso turning.

exercises.name: Dip (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the handles at about hip height and face away from the anchor. Grip one in each hand beside your hips, arms straight, and walk your feet forward a little so your weight is on your hands.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your hips between the handles, then press back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows pointing back, the handles close to your body and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Grip the handles upright with your palms facing each other. Walk your feet forward and lean back until your arms are straight in front of you at shoulder height and your body is straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to curl your body up toward your hands, then lower yourself until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line from head to heels and your upper arms still.

exercises.name: Oblique Knee Tuck (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the straps to hang about a foot above the floor. Put your feet in the foot cradles, face down, and walk your hands out into a plank, hands under your shoulders.

**Movement.** Pull both knees in toward one elbow, turning your hips, then push your legs back out to the plank. Do the next rep to the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your hands under your shoulders and your hips level when you are back in the plank.

exercises.name: Rollout (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the straps to about waist height. Face away from the anchor, hold a handle in each hand with your arms straight in front of your hips, and walk your feet back so you lean forward onto the straps, body straight.

**Movement.** Raise your arms forward and up past your head, letting your body lean further toward the floor, then pull your arms back down to your hips to bring yourself back up.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and your body in one line from head to heels, your hips not sagging.

exercises.name: Inverted Row (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the handles of a suspension trainer at about waist height. Hold one in each hand, palms facing in, walk your feet forward and lean back until your arms are straight and your body is straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Pull your chest up to your hands, elbows going back past your body, then lower until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and your heels in place.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Bicep Curl (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Join the two handles, or use one, and take it in one hand, palm facing up. Walk your feet forward and lean back until that arm is straight in front at shoulder height and your body is straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Bend your elbow to curl your body up until your hand is beside your forehead, then lower yourself until your arm is straight. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and square to the anchor, without twisting.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Suspension Trainer)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the handles at about chest height and face away from the anchor. Take a handle in each hand, palms down, and lean forward with your arms straight in front at shoulder height and your body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your body until your hands are beside your forehead, then straighten your arms to push back up.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line and your upper arms still at about shoulder height.

exercises.name: Tuck Jump
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.

**Movement.** Dip into a quarter squat and jump straight up, pulling both knees up toward your chest at the top. Straighten your legs to land on the balls of your feet with your knees bent, and go straight into the next jump.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and your knees in line with your toes as you land.

exercises.name: Tuck L-Sit
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor, or between parallettes, with your knees bent and your hands flat beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.

**Movement.** Press down through straight arms to lift your hips and feet off the floor, pulling your knees in toward your chest. Hold for the set time, then sit back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your back tall and your shoulders pushed down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Tuck Planche
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel with your hands on the floor beside your knees, shoulder-width apart, fingers turned out a little, arms straight.

**Movement.** Lean your shoulders forward past your hands and tuck your knees to your chest until your feet lift off the floor, balancing on your hands. Hold it for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight, your upper back rounded and your hips about level with your shoulders.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight above your shoulder in one hand. Bend that side's knee, foot flat, and put your other arm and leg out at about 45 degrees.

**Movement.** Roll onto your free elbow, then your hand, and lift your hips. Sweep your straight leg under you onto that knee, lift your hand and stand up out of the lunge. Reverse the steps to lie down. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your weighted arm straight and upright, and your eyes on the kettlebell.

exercises.name: Typewriter Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Take a pull-up bar overhead with your hands about twice shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, and hang on straight arms.

**Movement.** Rise until your chin clears the bar. Shift your body across to one hand, straightening the other arm along the bar, then across to the other hand and back to the middle, and lower to a hang.

**Keep steady.** Your chin at the height of the bar as you move across, and your legs still.

exercises.name: Tyson Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set your hands under your lower chest, about as wide as your shoulders, and step your feet back so the soles press against a wall behind you, body straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward your hands, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows close to your sides, your feet against the wall and your body in one straight line.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Seated Row (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a bench in front of a low cable, or sit at the low cable row, feet planted. Take a single handle in one hand, arm straight, and sit tall.

**Movement.** Pull the handle to the side of your waist, elbow going back past your body, then let it go forward until your arm is straight and your shoulder reaches forward. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright and square to the cable, without twisting or leaning back.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Straight-Arm Pulldown (Cable)
aliases: Unilateral Cross Body Cable Pull Down
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle on a cable above head height. Stand side-on to it and reach up and across your body with your far hand to take the handle, arm straight.

**Movement.** Pull the handle down and across in a wide arc until your hand is beside your hip on the far side, then let it rise back up along the same arc. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight, your torso still and your shoulder down away from your ear.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench. Plant one foot flat with the knee bent and lift the other foot off the floor.

**Movement.** Drive through your planted foot to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee, then lower them back toward the floor. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level, your chin down and your free foot off the floor.

exercises.name: Upper Back Foam Roll
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back with a foam roller across your upper back between your shoulder blades, knees bent and feet flat. Hold your head in your hands and lift your hips off the floor.

**Movement.** Push with your feet to roll back and forth from the bottom of your shoulder blades to the top of your shoulders. Roll for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your hips off the floor, your head resting in your hands and your elbows pointing forward.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a Smith machine bar at about mid-thigh height. Stand close to it, grip it with an overhand grip a little narrower than your shoulders and unhook it, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull the bar up close to your body with your elbows leading out to the sides until your upper arms are about level with your shoulders, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows higher than your hands and your torso upright, without leaning back.

exercises.name: Upright Row (EZ Bar)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding an EZ bar in front of your thighs with an overhand grip on the inner bends, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull the bar up close to your body with your elbows leading out to the sides until your upper arms are about level with your shoulders, then lower it until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows higher than your hands and your torso upright, without swinging or leaning back.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall holding two dumbbells against the fronts of your thighs, palms toward you, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull the dumbbells up close to your body with your elbows leading out to the sides until your upper arms are about level with your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows higher than your hands and your torso upright, without swinging.

exercises.name: V-Bar Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Fit a V-handle to the pulldown and sit with your thighs under the pads. Take the handle with your palms facing each other, arms straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the handle down to your upper chest, leaning back a little with your elbows close to your sides, then let it rise until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** The same small lean back, your thighs under the pads and no swing back and forth.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face up, legs straight and together, arms stretched out past your head on the floor.

**Movement.** Lift your arms and legs at the same time, folding at your hips, until your hands reach toward your feet above your hips, then lower both until they are just above the floor.

**Keep steady.** Your arms and legs straight throughout.

exercises.name: Walk
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall in comfortable shoes.

**Movement.** Walk at a steady pace for the set distance or time, heel down first and rolling through to your toes.

**Keep steady.** Your head up, your shoulders relaxed and your arms swinging naturally.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Bend forward at your hips and put your hands on the floor in front of your feet, knees as straight as you can keep them.

**Movement.** Walk your hands forward one at a time until you are in a plank on your hands, then walk your feet up toward your hands with small steps and stand up.

**Keep steady.** Your hips level and in line with your body when you reach the plank, and your legs as straight as you can keep them.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand tall with your feet together and your hands on your hips.

**Movement.** Take a long step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then push through your front foot and swing your back leg through into the next step. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your hips facing forward and your front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a wall about an arm's length away, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at your chest with your hands under it.

**Movement.** Squat down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand up hard and throw the ball up to a mark high on the wall. Catch it at your chest as it drops and go straight into the next squat.

**Keep steady.** Your chest up, your elbows under the ball and your heels down.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel facing away from a wall and put your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, about a foot from it. Walk your feet up the wall while you walk your hands in toward it.

**Movement.** Stop when your chest is close to the wall and your body is straight and upside down on straight arms, then hold it for the set time. Walk your hands out and your feet down to come off.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, your arms straight and your shoulders pushed up toward your ears.

exercises.name: Wall Kick Rotation
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hold the pool edge with one hand, body flat at the surface and face in the water.

**Movement.** Kick gently and turn your head and body to the side to breathe, then back down, for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your legs kicking all the time and your body long.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand about an arm's length from a wall and put your hands on it at shoulder height, a little wider than your shoulders. Step your feet back a little so your body leans toward the wall, straight from head to heels.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, then push back until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor sticking out.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet about shoulder-width apart, a step or two out from it.

**Movement.** Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are level with the floor and your knees are bent to a right angle. Hold the position for the set time.

**Keep steady.** Your back against the wall, your knees over your ankles and your hands off your thighs.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with your heels a few inches from a wall and your hips, upper back and head against it. Raise your arms with your upper arms at shoulder height and your elbows bent to a right angle, the backs of your arms and hands against the wall.

**Movement.** Slide your arms up the wall until they are almost straight overhead, then slide them back down to the start.

**Keep steady.** Your head, upper back and arms against the wall, without arching your lower back off it.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Fasten a dip belt with a weight plate around your hips. Grip parallel bars and press up until your arms are straight and your body hangs between them.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower yourself until your upper arms are level with the bars, then push back up to straight arms.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders down away from your ears, your legs still and the weight hanging under you without swinging.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion (Plate)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie on your back on a flat bench with your head and neck past its end. Hold a plate on your forehead with both hands, a folded towel under it.

**Movement.** Lower your head back below the level of the bench, then curl your chin up toward your chest. Lower it back down.

**Keep steady.** Your shoulders and back on the bench and the plate held in place on your forehead.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Fasten a dip belt with a weight plate around your hips. Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away, arms straight.

**Movement.** Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, then lower until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your legs still and the weight hanging under you, without kicking or swinging.

exercises.name: Weighted Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Get into a push-up position, hands a little wider than your shoulders and arms straight, and have a partner place a weight plate flat across your upper back.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows to lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and the plate level on your back.

exercises.name: Step-Up (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand facing a sturdy box or bench about knee height with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, and put one foot flat on top of it.

**Movement.** Push through that foot to step up until your leg is straight, bringing the other foot up beside it, then step back down with the other foot first. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your torso upright, your arms hanging still and your working knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
aliases: Jalón al Pecho con Agarre Ancho
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the pulldown with your thighs under the pads. Take the bar near its ends, hands well wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward, arms straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the bar down in front of your face to your upper chest, elbows going down and out to your sides, then let it rise until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright with only a slight lean back, and your thighs under the pads.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Underhand Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit at the pulldown with your thighs under the pads. Take the bar with your hands wider than your shoulders, palms facing you, arms straight overhead.

**Movement.** Pull the bar down past your chin to your upper chest, elbows going down and back, then let it rise until your arms are straight again.

**Keep steady.** Your body upright with no swing back and forth, and your thighs under the pads.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Put your hands on the floor well outside your shoulders and step your feet back so your body is straight from head to heels, arms straight.

**Movement.** Bend your elbows out to the sides to lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up until your arms are straight.

**Keep steady.** Your body in one straight line, hips neither sagging nor raised, and your hands in place.

exercises.name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight, and lift your legs straight up until your feet are near the bar, your body folded at the hips.

**Movement.** Lower your legs down to one side in an arc, keeping them straight and together, then bring them up through the middle and over to the other side. Alternate sides; each side counts its own reps.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and your upper body facing forward, with only your hips and legs turning.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Start in a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders. Step one foot forward to the outside of the hand on that side, back knee off the floor.

**Movement.** Drop the elbow on your front foot's side toward its instep, then turn your chest and reach that arm up to the ceiling. Put that hand down, push your hips back to straighten your front leg, then return to the lunge. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your back leg straight and your other hand on the floor.

exercises.name: Wrist Circle
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand or sit and hold your arms out in front of you, hands in loose fists.

**Movement.** Circle your hands at the wrists, as wide as they go, one way for half the reps and then the other way. Each full circle is a rep.

**Keep steady.** Your forearms still, so only your wrists move.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set a single handle at the bottom of a cable. Sit facing it on a bench and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm up, wrist just past your knee, with the handle in that hand.

**Movement.** Let your wrist bend back toward the cable, then curl it up as far as it goes. Do every rep on one side, then switch.

**Keep steady.** Your forearm on your thigh and your elbow still.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up. Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists are just past your knees.

**Movement.** Let your wrists bend back to lower the dumbbells, then curl them up as high as they go.

**Keep steady.** Your forearms on your thighs and your elbows still.

exercises.name: Wrist Rock
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Kneel on all fours with your hands flat on the floor under your shoulders, fingers pointing forward, and your knees under your hips.

**Movement.** Shift your weight forward over your hands as far as your wrists comfortably bend, then rock back until your hips are over your knees.

**Keep steady.** Your palms flat on the floor and your arms straight.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Hang a plate from the rope of a wrist roller with the rope fully unwound. Stand tall and hold the roller's bar in both hands, palms down, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.

**Movement.** Turn the bar one hand after the other so the rope coils around it and the plate rises to the bar, then turn it the other way to lower the plate back down.

**Keep steady.** Your arms straight and level with your shoulders, and your body upright.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Reach one arm forward at shoulder height, straight, with the palm turned up.

**Movement.** Bend that wrist back so your fingers point to the floor, then use your other hand to draw the fingers back toward you until you feel it along the inside of your forearm. Hold the stretch for the set time, then switch sides.

**Keep steady.** Your arm straight and your shoulder down.

exercises.name: YTWL Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down on a bench set at about 30 to 45 degrees, a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.

**Movement.** Raise your arms forward into a Y and lower them, out to the sides into a T and lower them, then pull your elbows back into a W. Finish with an L: upper arms out to the sides, elbows bent to 90 degrees, forearms turned up. One round of all four is one rep.

**Keep steady.** Your chest on the pad, your thumbs up for the Y and T, and your neck long.

exercises.name: YWT Raise
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Lie face down on a mat, legs straight. Reach your arms overhead in a Y, thumbs up.

**Movement.** Lift your arms and chest a little off the floor and lower them. Do the same with your elbows pulled down beside your ribs in a W, then with your arms straight out to the sides in a T. One Y, W and T make one rep.

**Keep steady.** Your legs on the floor, your neck in line with your back and your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Set the bar in a rack at about the height of your lower ribs. Slide your bent arms under it so it sits in the crooks of your elbows, hands together, and stand up to lift it off. Step back and set your feet about shoulder-width apart.

**Movement.** Bend your hips and knees and sit down until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then stand back up.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows bent tight, the bar against your body, your torso upright and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
**Setup.** Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight at your sides, palms facing forward.

**Movement.** Curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders, turn your palms to face down at the top, and lower them that way until your arms are straight. Turn your palms forward again before the next rep.

**Keep steady.** Your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still, without swinging your body.
